items.title: [Correspondence] Making rehabilitation indicators disability-inclusive
items.summary: A correspondence argues that the WHO's rehabilitation indicators, while important, risk overlooking structural and social inequalities in access to rehabilitation, potentially limiting their ability to ensure a measurable path to independence and participation for all.
items.curatedReason: 这篇通讯呼吁 WHO 在制定康复指标时，要更全面地考量残障人士面临的结构性和社会不平等。它提醒您，康复的最终目标不仅是功能独立，还需关注宏观层面的社会公平。
items.titleZh: 让康复指标更具残障包容性
items.summaryZh: 一篇通讯指出，世界卫生组织（WHO）的康复指标虽然重要，但可能忽视了康复服务获取中的结构性与社会不平等，这可能会限制其在确保残障人士独立与参与方面的衡量效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This correspondence calls for WHO to comprehensively consider structural and social inequalities faced by people with disabilities when developing rehabilitation indicators. It reminds you that the ultimate goal of rehabilitation is not only functional independence but also broader social equity.

items.title: International school-based physical activity promotion programmes for children in socio-economically disadvantaged contexts in high-income countries: a narrative review and structured analysis
items.summary: A narrative review and structured analysis identified that school-based physical activity interventions in socio-economically disadvantaged contexts in high-income countries benefit from hybrid implementation models and highly adapted programs, ensuring contextual fit and local ownership.
items.curatedReason: 在高收入国家社会经济弱势地区推行校内体育活动，成功的关键在于采用混合实施模式和高度本地化的项目。这意味着你必须深入社区，确保干预措施与当地语境高度契合，并激发当地居民的自主性。
items.titleZh: 高收入国家社会经济弱势地区儿童校内体育活动推广项目：叙述性综述与结构分析
items.summaryZh: 一项叙述性综述与结构分析发现，在高收入国家社会经济弱势地区，校内体育活动干预项目若采用混合实施模式和高度适应性方案，能更好地实现情境契合和本地所有权。
items.curatedReasonEn: For school-based physical activity interventions in socio-economically disadvantaged contexts in high-income countries, success hinges on hybrid implementation models and highly adapted programs. This means you must engage deeply with communities to ensure interventions are contextually tailored and foster local ownership.
items.limitation: 该综述的实施条件合成仅限于研究明确报告的信息，可能存在信息遗漏。
items.limitationEn: The synthesis of implementation conditions in this review was limited to explicitly reported information, potentially leading to omissions.

items.title: Designing a novel running intervention for adults with chronic low back pain (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: A PhD thesis aimed to design and evaluate a novel running intervention for adults with chronic low back pain (LBP) to achieve clinically meaningful reductions in pain intensity and disability, also exploring beliefs about running safety as a barrier.
items.curatedReason: 这项博士研究正在探索跑步对慢性下腰痛（LBP）患者的干预效果。初步结果可能提示跑步是一种可行的 LBP 管理方案，但请注意，在推荐跑步前，你应充分评估患者对跑步安全性的顾虑及个体情况。
items.titleZh: 为慢性下腰痛成人设计一种新型跑步干预（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 一项博士论文旨在设计并评估一种针对慢性下腰痛（LBP）成人患者的新型跑步干预措施，以实现疼痛强度和残疾的临床显著改善，并探讨了对跑步安全性的信念是否构成参与障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD research is exploring the effects of running as an intervention for adults with chronic low back pain (LBP). Initial findings may suggest running is a viable LBP management option, but before recommending it, you should thoroughly assess patients' beliefs about running safety and their individual circumstances.
items.limitation: 研究设计仅为单一干预方案的设计与评估，缺乏与无治疗对照组的比较数据。
items.limitationEn: The study design is limited to the design and evaluation of a single intervention, lacking comparative data with a no-treatment control group.

items.title: Associations of Patient-Reported and Objective Measures of Mobility With Prospective Falls in Older Adults with Multiple Sclerosis
items.summary: This study evaluated associations between the patient determined disease steps (PDDS) scale and the short physical performance battery (SPPB) with prospective falls in older adults with multiple sclerosis (OAMS), aiming to address a gap in the literature.
items.curatedReason: 对于多发性硬化症老年患者的跌倒风险评估，本研究提示患者自评的疾病分级量表（PDDS）和客观的短期体能表现电池（SPPB）均有参考价值。在临床实践中，你可以考虑结合两者，进行更全面的跌倒风险预测与干预。
items.titleZh: 多发性硬化症老年患者自评和客观移动能力测量与未来跌倒的关联
items.summaryZh: 本研究旨在评估患者自评疾病分级量表（PDDS）和短期体能表现电池（SPPB）与多发性硬化症（MS）老年患者未来跌倒之间的关联，以填补文献空白。
items.curatedReasonEn: For fall risk assessment in older adults with multiple sclerosis, this study suggests both the patient-determined disease steps (PDDS) scale and the objective short physical performance battery (SPPB) are valuable. In clinical practice, you might consider combining both for a more comprehensive fall risk prediction and intervention.
items.limitation: 研究未报告具体的样本量和统计结果，限制了对结论强度的判断。
items.limitationEn: The study did not report specific sample size or statistical results, limiting the ability to judge the strength of the conclusions.

items.title: Effects of TENS, NMES, and Combination Therapy on Hemiplegic Shoulder Pain and Function After Stroke.
items.summary: This prospective randomized study (n=60) found that combined TENS and NMES significantly reduced hemiplegic shoulder pain and improved SPADI scores more than TENS alone, and also improved shoulder ROM, in acute and subacute stroke patients, when added to a standardized rehabilitation program.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后偏瘫肩痛的早期康复，整合电刺激可能比单一模式效果更好，尤其在疼痛和肩关节功能方面。尽管对整体运动功能和痉挛影响不大，但可作为一种有益的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: TENS、NMES 及联合疗法对卒中后偏瘫肩痛和功能的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项前瞻性随机研究（n=60）发现，在急性及亚急性卒中患者的标准康复计划中，联合使用 TENS 和 NMES 能显著减轻偏瘫肩痛、改善肩痛与残疾指数（SPADI）评分，并增加肩关节活动度，效果优于单独使用 TENS。
items.curatedReasonEn: For early stroke rehabilitation, integrated electrical stimulation may be more effective than unimodal approaches for hemiplegic shoulder pain and function. While not significantly impacting overall motor function or spasticity, it can be a beneficial adjunct.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且结合疗法与NMES单用在SPADI评分上无显著差异，提示仍需更大规模研究验证长期效果。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size, and the combined therapy showed no significant difference compared to NMES alone on SPADI scores, suggesting larger studies are needed to confirm long-term effects.

items.title: Recovery Trajectories of Lower Limb Motor Function After Cervical Spinal Cord Injury: A Latent Class Mixed Model Analysis
items.summary: This study employed a latent class mixed model analysis to investigate the recovery trajectories of lower limb motor function following cervical spinal cord injury, aiming to inform treatment strategies and rehabilitation programs.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究利用潜在类别混合模型分析了颈髓损伤后下肢运动功能的恢复轨迹，它能帮助您更好地理解患者在不同阶段的功能变化，从而更精准地制定康复计划。
items.titleZh: 颈髓损伤后下肢运动功能恢复轨迹：潜在类别混合模型分析
items.summaryZh: 本研究采用潜在类别混合模型分析法，探讨了颈髓损伤后下肢运动功能的恢复轨迹，旨在为治疗策略和康复计划的制定提供依据。
items.curatedReasonEn: Lower limb motor function recovery after cervical spinal cord injury is not monolithic; this study, using latent class mixed model analysis, identified distinct recovery trajectories. This implies that when developing rehabilitation plans, you should individualize them, optimizing intervention strategies based on the patient's specific recovery pattern.
items.limitation: 摘要未提供研究设计细节、样本量和具体的恢复轨迹数据，限制了对结论的全面理解。
items.limitationEn: The abstract lacks details on study design, sample size, and specific recovery trajectory data, limiting a comprehensive understanding of the conclusions.

items.title: [Correspondence] Physical activity and exercise training in patients with HFrEF
items.summary: A correspondence highlights the omission of guideline-recommended physical activity counseling and supervised exercise training in a recent seminar on HFrEF, emphasizing its benefits in combination with pharmacotherapy.
items.curatedReason: 这篇通讯强调，在管理射血分数降低型心力衰竭 (HFrEF) 患者时，物理活动咨询和监督运动训练的重要性不应被忽视，它提醒您在联合药物治疗时，需将运动康复纳入整体管理方案。
items.titleZh: 射血分数降低型心力衰竭患者的体力活动与运动训练
items.summaryZh: 一篇通讯指出，近期关于射血分数降低型心力衰竭（HFrEF）的研讨会忽视了指南推荐的体力活动咨询和监督运动训练，强调其与药物治疗结合的益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This correspondence emphasizes that physical activity counseling and supervised exercise training should not be overlooked in managing patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). It reminds you to integrate exercise rehabilitation into the overall management plan alongside pharmacotherapy.

items.title: Vestibular rehabilitation therapy in Turkey: insights into physical therapists' clinical practice.
items.summary: A survey of 178 physical therapists in Turkey found that 88.8% lacked VRT experience, with only 1.2% using specialized equipment and significant unfamiliarity (over 60%) with common VRT maneuvers and techniques.
items.curatedReason: 这项土耳其调研揭示了当地物理治疗师在前庭康复治疗方面的知识和实践差距。这提示在快速引入新技术时，专业培训的普及往往滞后于临床需求。
items.titleZh: 土耳其物理治疗师前庭康复治疗临床实践洞察
items.summaryZh: 一项对土耳其 178 名物理治疗师的调查发现，88.8% 的人缺乏前庭康复治疗（VRT）经验，仅 1.2% 使用了专用设备，并且超过 60% 的人对常见 VRT 手法和技术不熟悉。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey from Turkey reveals significant gaps in knowledge and clinical practice among local physical therapists regarding vestibular rehabilitation. It highlights that the widespread adoption of new techniques often outpaces professional training and implementation.
items.limitation: 本研究为开放式问卷调查，无法确定回复率，且样本量较小，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was an open survey, so the response rate could not be determined, and the small sample size may introduce selection bias.

items.title: Faith, culture and physical activity: addressing participation barriers in UK Muslim communities
items.summary: This article explores the faith and cultural barriers impacting physical activity participation within UK Muslim communities, highlighting lower reported physical activity levels despite diverse backgrounds and demographics.
items.curatedReason: 英国穆斯林社区的体育活动参与度较低，这可能与信仰和文化障碍有关。设计运动干预策略时，你应充分考虑这些因素，才能确保方案的文化适宜性和有效性。
items.titleZh: 信仰、文化与体育活动：解决英国穆斯林社区的参与障碍
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了影响英国穆斯林社区体育活动参与的信仰和文化障碍，强调尽管背景和人口结构多样，但该群体报告的体育活动水平普遍较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: Lower physical activity levels in UK Muslim communities may stem from faith and cultural barriers. When designing exercise interventions, you must thoroughly consider these factors to ensure cultural appropriateness and effectiveness.

items.title: Physical activity interventions for promoting 24-hour movement behaviours, physical fitness, fundamental movement skills and cognitive function in Chinese preschoolers (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: A doctoral research project explored physical activity and eHealth interventions to improve 24-hour movement behaviors, physical fitness, fundamental movement skills, and cognitive function in Chinese preschoolers, combining evidence syntheses with real-world, culturally tailored programs.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，在改善中国学龄前儿童的 24 小时运动行为和认知功能方面，结合证据综合与文化适宜的 eHealth 干预可能有效。这为你将理论与数字技术应用于早期儿童健康促进提供了思路。
items.titleZh: 体育活动干预对中国学龄前儿童24小时运动行为、体能、基本运动技能和认知功能的影响（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 一项博士研究项目探讨了体育活动和电子健康干预如何改善中国学龄前儿童的 24 小时运动行为、体能、基本运动技能和认知功能，结合证据合成与现实世界中、文化适宜的干预方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD research focuses on 24-hour movement behaviors and cognitive function interventions for Chinese preschoolers. It can help you understand how to integrate theory and digital technology to provide culturally tailored solutions for early childhood health promotion.

items.title: When evidence fails in real life: Rethinking sports injury rehabilitation and prevention.
items.summary: This perspective critically examines traditional linear and reductionist models in sports injury prevention and rehabilitation, advocating for a more integrated, complexity-informed framework. It reinterprets evidence-based practice and applies a dynamic biopsychosocial model to better address real-world injury patterns and tailor patient-centered care.
items.curatedReason: 这篇文章是对运动损伤康复和预防中传统线性、还原论模型的批判性反思。它提醒你，在实践中应超越单一风险因素和标准化干预，采用整合复杂科学、循证实践和动态生物心理社会模型的综合框架。
items.titleZh: 当证据在现实中失效：重新思考运动损伤康复与预防。
items.summaryZh: 本文批判性地审视了运动损伤预防与康复中传统的线性还原论模型，提倡采用整合复杂科学、循证实践和动态生物心理社会模型的综合框架。这有助于更好地应对现实世界的损伤模式，并提供以患者为中心的个性化治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This paper offers a critical reflection on traditional linear, reductionist models in sports injury rehabilitation and prevention. It reminds you to move beyond isolated risk factors and standardized interventions, adopting a comprehensive framework that integrates complexity science, evidence-based practice, and a dynamic biopsychosocial model.

items.title: Effects of High-Intensity Laser Therapy on Functional Outcomes and Spasticity-Related Pain in Subacute and Chronic Stroke Patients with Plantar Flexor Spasticity: A Randomized Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized sham-controlled trial (n=24) found that high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) combined with conventional rehabilitation for subacute and chronic stroke patients with plantar flexor spasticity significantly reduced spasticity-related pain and showed a covariate-adjusted gait benefit. However, it had no effect on spasticity or muscle thickness, and gait benefits require confirmation in larger trials.
items.curatedReason: 高强度激光治疗（HILT）作为卒中后足跖屈痉挛的辅助手段，可以显著、持久地减轻痉挛相关疼痛，并可能带来较小的步态速度改善。然而，激光治疗对痉挛和肌肉厚度无显著影响，且步态改善的临床意义尚不确定。
items.titleZh: 高强度激光治疗对亚急性和慢性卒中足跖屈痉挛患者功能结局和痉挛相关疼痛的影响：一项随机假对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机假对照试验（n=24）发现，高强度激光治疗（HILT）作为亚急性和慢性卒中足跖屈痉挛患者常规康复的辅助手段，显著减轻了痉挛相关疼痛，并表现出协变量调整后的步态改善。但其对痉挛和肌肉厚度无影响，且步态改善的临床意义尚需更大规模试验验证。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-intensity laser therapy (HILT) as an adjunct for post-stroke plantar flexor spasticity can significantly and durably reduce spasticity-related pain, with a possible smaller benefit in gait speed. However, laser therapy showed no significant effect on spasticity or muscle thickness, and the clinical magnitude of gait improvement remains uncertain.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（24 例），且部分结局指标（步态速度改善）的临床意义仍需在更大规模、高功率的研究中进一步确证。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (n=24), and the clinical significance of some outcome measures (gait speed improvement) requires further confirmation in larger, adequately powered trials.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: The Added Value of Neural Mobilization Techniques to Proprioceptive Neuromuscular Facilitation in Patients With Adhesive Capsulitis: Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=56) found that combining neural mobilization techniques (NMTs) with proprioceptive neuromuscular facilitation (PNF) and conventional physical therapy for adhesive capsulitis resulted in statistically significant short-term improvements in pain, disability, and passive shoulder ROM. Only shoulder abduction (14.08°) showed a clinically meaningful benefit, while pain and disability did not reach MCID thresholds.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，对于冻结肩患者，在常规康复和 PNF 基础上增加神经松动术，能在肩关节活动度（外展 14.08°）上获得额外改善，且具有临床意义。然而，疼痛和功能障碍的改善未达 MCID。
items.titleZh: 神经松动技术联合本体感觉神经肌肉易化技术在冻结肩患者中的附加价值：随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=56）发现，神经松动技术（NMTs）联合本体感觉神经肌肉易化（PNF）和常规物理治疗对冻结肩患者的短期疼痛、功能障碍和肩关节被动活动度有统计学显著改善。其中仅肩关节外展（14.08°）的改善具有临床意义，而疼痛和功能障碍未达最小临床重要差异（MCID）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that adding neural mobilization to conventional physical therapy and PNF for adhesive capsulitis can provide additional, clinically meaningful improvements in shoulder abduction (14.08°). However, improvements in pain and disability did not reach the MCID.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（56 例），且随访期仅为 6 周，疼痛和功能障碍改善未达临床最小重要差异，提示需要更大规模、更长期的研究来确证这些发现。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (n=56) and a short 6-week follow-up period. Improvements in pain and disability did not reach the MCID, suggesting that larger, longer-term studies are needed to confirm these findings.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Approach to sarcopenia in older adults: a systematic review of dietary and exercise interventions in the primary care setting
items.summary: A systematic review of 6 studies (n=444 in experimental groups) on sarcopenia in older adults found that combined physical exercise and nutritional supplementation in primary care settings demonstrated notable improvements in muscle strength, physical function, and body composition, though results varied with study design and adherence.
items.curatedReason: 初级保健环境中结合营养补充的运动干预对老年肌少症患者的肌肉力量、身体功能和身体成分有益。这意味着你在管理老年肌少症患者时，应积极推荐并与营养师协作，制定多维度的综合干预方案。
items.titleZh: 老年肌少症的治疗方法：初级保健环境中膳食和运动干预的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项针对老年肌少症的系统综述纳入6项研究（实验组n=444），发现在初级保健环境中结合体力运动和营养补充可显著改善肌肉力量、身体功能和身体成分，但结果因研究设计和依从性而异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Combined exercise interventions with nutritional supplementation in primary care settings benefit older adults with sarcopenia in terms of muscle strength, physical function, and body composition. This implies that when managing older sarcopenic patients, you should actively recommend and collaborate with nutritionists to develop multidimensional, integrated intervention programs.
items.limitation: 系统综述仅纳入了6项研究，且各研究设计和依从性存在差异，可能影响结果的总体一致性。
items.limitationEn: The systematic review included only 6 studies, and variations in study design and adherence rates across these studies may affect the overall consistency of the results.

items.title: Effects of neuromuscular electrical stimulation combined with blood flow restriction training on lower-leg neuromuscular function in individuals with chronic ankle instability: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=60) found that adding combined neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) and blood flow restriction training (BFRT) to an 8-week exercise program for chronic ankle instability patients resulted in higher FAAM-Sports scores than exercise alone and NMES alone, with a broader pattern of favorable changes in secondary outcomes like PL activation and eversion strength.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性踝关节不稳患者，在标准化运动方案中加入神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）和血流限制训练（BFRT）的组合可能比单独运动带来更广泛的短期益处，尤其在腓骨长肌激活和踝关节外翻力量方面。但这并非在所有结局指标上都显示出一致优势，将其视为现有方案的辅助强化手段。
items.titleZh: 神经肌肉电刺激联合血流限制训练对慢性踝关节不稳患者小腿神经肌肉功能的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=60）发现，对于慢性踝关节不稳患者，在8周运动方案中加入神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）和血流限制训练（BFRT）的组合，与单独运动或单独NMES相比，可显著提高FAAM-Sports评分，并在腓骨长肌激活和踝关节外翻力量等次要结局中表现出更广泛的改善模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: For individuals with chronic ankle instability, combining neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) and blood flow restriction training (BFRT) with a standardized exercise program may offer broader short-term benefits than exercise alone, particularly in peroneus longus activation and ankle eversion strength. However, this advantage was not consistent across all outcomes. Consider it an adjunctive enhancement to existing protocols.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（n=60），随访期仅为8周，限制了结果的长期外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size (n=60) and a short follow-up period of only 8 weeks, limiting the long-term generalizability of the results.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Machine learning-based identification of a minimal wearable sensor for gait assessment in vestibular schwannoma
items.summary: A study used machine learning to identify optimal wearable sensor configurations for gait assessment in vestibular schwannoma, finding that a wrist-worn sensor during eyes-closed gait (FGA8) provided 60-83% accuracy in discriminating patients from controls, suggesting a minimal, clinically deployable solution for objective gait analysis.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究提示，在闭眼步态任务中佩戴腕部传感器，对前庭神经鞘瘤患者的步态评估准确率可达60-83%。这个方案操作简便，可能成为门诊或远程监测前庭功能障碍患者步态和平衡的补充工具，但目前还不能替代全面的临床评估。
items.titleZh: 基于机器学习识别用于前庭神经鞘瘤步态评估的最少可穿戴传感器
items.summaryZh: 一项研究利用机器学习识别出用于前庭神经鞘瘤步态评估的最优可穿戴传感器配置，发现闭眼步态（FGA8）期间的腕部传感器在区分患者和对照组方面达到60-83%的准确率，提示了一种用于客观步态分析的最小化、临床可部署解决方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study suggests that a wrist-worn sensor during eyes-closed gait tasks can achieve 60-83% accuracy in assessing gait for vestibular schwannoma patients. While this simple solution could supplement in-clinic or remote monitoring of gait and balance in patients with vestibular disorders, it's not yet a substitute for comprehensive clinical evaluation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（32名患者），且结果主要基于机器学习模型的分类准确性而非临床结局的直接改善。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size (32 patients), and the results are primarily based on the classification accuracy of machine learning models rather than direct improvements in clinical outcomes.

items.title: Rotational perturbation training improves muscle coordination during reactive standing balance in trained and untrained conditions in children with spastic cerebral palsy
items.summary: A longitudinal intervention study (n=14 children with cerebral palsy) found that 3 weeks of rotational perturbation training improved the ability to maintain standing balance and decreased muscle co-activation and average reactive muscle activity in response to both trained rotational and untrained translational perturbations.
items.curatedReason: 旋转扰动训练能改善痉挛型脑瘫儿童的反应性平衡，且这种改善具有泛化性。这提示你可以考虑将此类扰动训练整合到脑瘫儿童的康复方案中，以提高其应对未知平衡挑战的能力。
items.titleZh: 旋转扰动训练改善痉挛型脑瘫儿童在受训和未受训条件下的反应性站立平衡期间的肌肉协调性
items.summaryZh: 一项纵向干预研究（n=14名痉挛型脑瘫儿童）发现，3周的旋转扰动训练提高了受试者在受训和未受训旋转扰动条件下维持站立平衡的能力，并降低了肌肉共激活和平均反应性肌肉活动。
items.curatedReasonEn: Rotational perturbation training improves reactive balance in children with spastic cerebral palsy, and this improvement generalizes to untrained conditions. This suggests you can consider integrating such perturbation training into rehabilitation programs for children with cerebral palsy to enhance their ability to cope with unexpected balance challenges.
items.limitation: 这是一项纵向干预研究，而非随机对照试验，且样本量较小（14名脑瘫儿童），可能存在选择偏倚，结果外推需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This was a longitudinal intervention study, not a randomized controlled trial, and had a small sample size (14 children with cerebral palsy), which may introduce selection bias and limits the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Ahpra and the National Boards invite feedback on practitioner codes of conduct
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) and the National Boards are reviewing practitioner codes of conduct, inviting health practitioners, consumers, and stakeholders to participate in an early scoping survey by October 15, 2026, to help shape the updates.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构（Ahpra）正在审查其行为准则。你作为在澳大利亚执业的物理治疗师，应抓住机会通过参与调查提供反馈，以确保修订后的行为准则能够准确反映行业需求和公众期望，这将直接影响你未来的执业标准和职业伦理。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构——Ahpra 和国家委员会征集从业者行为准则反馈意见
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构（Ahpra）和国家委员会正在审查从业者行为准则，邀请医疗从业者、消费者和利益相关者参与初步范围界定调查，截止日期为2026年10月15日，以帮助形成更新内容。
items.curatedReasonEn: Ahpra is reviewing its codes of conduct. As a physical therapist practicing in Australia, you should seize this opportunity to provide feedback through the survey to ensure the revised codes accurately reflect industry needs and public expectations. This will directly impact your future practice standards and professional ethics.

items.title: Recent clinical practice guidelines for the management of low back pain: a global comparison
items.summary: A systematic review comparing 22 recent global clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) for low back pain found heterogeneity in recommendations, particularly across different stages of LBP. Common recommendations for acute, subacute, and chronic LBP include therapeutic exercise, NSAIDs, and spinal manipulation.
items.curatedReason: 不同国家和组织发布的腰痛临床实践指南存在异质性，这意味着你在参考指南时需要注意其适用背景和推荐差异。该综述没有提供具体指南的更新或推荐等级的改变，但确认了治疗性运动、NSAIDs和脊柱手法是常见推荐。
items.titleZh: 近期下腰痛管理临床实践指南：全球比较
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述比较了全球22项近期下腰痛临床实践指南，发现各指南的推荐存在异质性，尤其在腰痛的不同阶段。急慢性腰痛的常见推荐包括治疗性运动、NSAIDs和脊柱手法。
items.curatedReasonEn: Clinical practice guidelines for low back pain from various countries and organizations show heterogeneity. Be aware of their applicability and differing recommendations when consulting them. This review does not provide specific guideline updates or changes in recommendation grades, but confirms therapeutic exercise, NSAIDs, and spinal manipulation as common recommendations.
items.limitation: 该系统综述侧重于全球指南的比较，未深入评估单一指南的具体证据等级或实践影响。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review focuses on comparing global guidelines and does not deeply assess the specific evidence level or practical impact of any single guideline.

items.title: How APTA Is Advancing Alternative Payment Models
items.summary: APTA is piloting its GOALS (Growing Older and Living Stronger) model, an early frailty identification and intervention program, with Hartford HealthCare. This initiative aims to generate real-world evidence for value-based care and payment, measuring outcomes like function, falls, and hospitalizations to inform future payment for PT services.
items.curatedReason: APTA正在通过其GOALS模型推动物理治疗领域的替代支付模式，重点关注衰弱筛查和干预，以验证基于价值的护理。这提示你要密切关注这类模式的进展，了解其对物理治疗服务报销和实践可能产生的影响。
items.titleZh: APTA 如何推进替代支付模式
items.summaryZh: APTA正与哈特福德医疗康复网络试点其GOALS模型，这是一个早期衰弱识别和干预项目。该倡议旨在为价值导向的护理和支付提供真实世界证据，通过衡量功能、跌倒和住院等结局，为物理治疗服务的未来支付模式提供信息。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA is advancing alternative payment models in physical therapy through its GOALS model, focusing on frailty screening and intervention to validate value-based care. Stay informed about the progress of such models and their potential impact on physical therapy service reimbursement and practice.

items.title: Why Revenue Cycle Operations Are Ready for Change
items.summary: The article discusses how rehabilitation therapy revenue cycle operations are primed for technological change, with advancements in machine learning enabling automation to simplify complex billing, claims management, and payment processes that have traditionally lagged behind other industries.
items.curatedReason: 该文章指出康复治疗的收入周期管理正面临技术变革，有望通过自动化解决复杂的报销和索赔流程。这意味着你诊所的收入运营模式需要与时俱进，利用新兴技术提高效率，以应对日益复杂的支付环境。
items.titleZh: 为什么收入周期运营已准备好迎接变革
items.summaryZh: 文章探讨了康复治疗收入周期运营如何为技术变革做好准备，机器学习的进步将实现自动化，从而简化传统上落后于其他行业的复杂账单、索赔管理和支付流程。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article highlights that revenue cycle management in rehabilitation therapy is undergoing technological change, with automation poised to address complex reimbursement and claims processes. This means your clinic's revenue operations must keep pace with technology to improve efficiency in an increasingly complex payment environment.

items.title: Physical Exercise Reduces Fall-Related Outcomes Among People With Stroke: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 studies (1536 participants) found that physical exercise significantly reduced the number of falls by 39% (IRR = 0.61, 95% CI = [0.47, 0.78]) among people with stroke. Balance training and programs integrating cognitive components were most effective, particularly for those in the chronic stage with mild to moderate disability.
items.curatedReason: 卒中患者的跌倒预防，运动干预是实打实的一线策略，别再犹豫了。特别是对于慢性期、轻中度残疾患者，平衡训练和认知结合的双任务训练效果最突出，能减少 39% 的跌倒。
items.titleZh: 物理运动可减少卒中患者跌倒相关事件：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 18 项研究（1536 名参与者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，物理运动显著减少了卒中患者的跌倒次数达 39% (IRR = 0.61, 95% CI = [0.47, 0.78])。其中，平衡训练以及结合认知成分的训练对慢性期轻中度残疾患者最为有效。
items.curatedReasonEn: For stroke patients, exercise is a proven first-line strategy for fall prevention; don't hesitate. Balance training and dual-task exercises integrating cognitive components are particularly effective for those in the chronic stage with mild to moderate disability, reducing falls by 39%.
items.limitation: 研究未详细阐述各干预措施的具体剂量-反应关系及长期依从性数据。
items.limitationEn: The review did not detail the dose-response relationship of various interventions or long-term adherence data.

items.title: Effects of Using High-Frequency TENS During an Exercise Therapy Program in Knee Osteoarthritis: A Randomized Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized sham-controlled trial (n=96) found that adding high-frequency transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation to an exercise therapy program did not provide additional benefits over sham stimulation for knee osteoarthritis pain or other outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 高频 TENS 对膝骨关节炎运动疗法的增益并不显著。在临床实践中，您不应将高频 TENS 视为提升运动疗法效果的关键补充手段。
items.titleZh: 高频 TENS 在膝骨关节炎运动疗法中的效果：一项随机假对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机假对照试验（n=96）显示，在膝骨关节炎患者的运动疗法中加入高频经皮电神经刺激，并未比假刺激带来额外的疼痛改善或其他益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-frequency TENS does not significantly augment the benefits of exercise therapy for knee osteoarthritis. Clinically, you should not rely on high-frequency TENS as a crucial adjunct to enhance exercise therapy outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究未正式评估盲法，随访期较短，且缺乏单独运动组作为对照。
items.limitationEn: The study did not formally assess blinding, had a short follow-up period, and lacked an exercise-only control group.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Implementation of group-based health education and exercise for individuals with knee osteoarthritis in brazilian primary health care: a mixed-methods study.
items.summary: A mixed-methods implementation study (n=84) in Brazilian primary care found that a 12-week physical therapist-led, group-based exercise and education program for knee osteoarthritis was feasible, well-accepted, and showed exploratory improvements in pain and function.
items.curatedReason: 本研究表明，由物理治疗师主导的膝骨关节炎团体运动和健康教育在巴西基层医疗中具有良好可行性。这为您在资源有限地区推广循证干预提供了实践参考。
items.titleZh: 巴西基层医疗中膝骨关节炎患者团体健康教育和运动的实施：一项混合方法研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项在巴西基层医疗中进行的混合方法实施研究（n=84）发现，由物理治疗师主导的为期 12 周膝骨关节炎团体运动和教育项目可行性高、接受度好，并显示出疼痛和功能的探索性改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that physical therapist-led group-based exercise and health education for knee osteoarthritis is highly feasible in Brazilian primary health care. This offers practical insights for implementing evidence-based interventions in resource-limited settings.
items.limitation: 这是一项混合方法实施研究，探索性临床结果提示改善，但需要前瞻性对照研究来确认干预的有效性。
items.limitationEn: This was a mixed-methods implementation study with exploratory clinical outcomes, suggesting improvements, but prospective controlled studies are needed to confirm intervention effectiveness.

items.title: Association Between Therapeutic Education Delivered by a Community Post-Stroke Rehabilitation Team and Improvement in the Frenchay Activities Index: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=163) found that home-based therapeutic patient education delivered by a Community Stroke Rehabilitation Team was associated with greater improvement in social participation after stroke, especially when combined with physical activity workshops.
items.curatedReason: 社区卒中康复团队提供的居家治疗性教育（特别是结合体育活动工作坊）与卒中后社会参与的显著改善相关。在为卒中患者规划康复方案时，应考虑纳入这类教育和活动。
items.titleZh: 社区卒中康复团队提供的治疗性教育与 Frenchay 活动指数改善之间的关联：一项回顾性队列研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（n=163）发现，社区卒中康复团队提供的居家治疗性患者教育，特别是结合体育活动工作坊时，与卒中后社会参与的显著改善相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Home-based therapeutic education, particularly when combined with physical activity workshops, delivered by community stroke rehabilitation teams, is associated with significant improvements in social participation post-stroke. When planning rehabilitation programs for stroke patients, consider integrating such education and activities.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，尽管进行了多变量调整，但仍无法完全排除混杂因素，需要前瞻性对照研究来确定因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study; despite multivariate adjustments, confounding factors cannot be entirely excluded, and prospective controlled studies are needed to establish causality.

items.title: Immediate and fatigue-related effects of subtalar sling taping in individuals with chronic ankle instability.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=90) found that rigid and Kinesio subtalar sling taping showed outcome-dependent effects on Y-Balance Test and other functional outcomes in individuals with chronic ankle instability immediately and after fatigue, with no consistent superiority between the two active tapings.
items.curatedReason: 无论是僵性还是肌内效贴布的距下关节吊带贴扎，在慢性踝关节不稳患者中，即时及疲劳相关效应均具有一定的产出依赖性。在临床使用时，您应根据具体功能指标评估其效果，而非预期普适性改善。
items.titleZh: 距下关节吊带贴扎对慢性踝关节不稳患者的即时及疲劳相关影响。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=90）发现，僵性与肌内效距下关节吊带贴扎在慢性踝关节不稳患者中，对 Y-平衡测试及其他功能结果的即时和疲劳相关效应具有产出依赖性，两种主动贴扎之间没有持续的优越性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both rigid and Kinesio subtalar sling taping demonstrate outcome-dependent immediate and fatigue-related effects in individuals with chronic ankle instability. In clinical practice, you should evaluate their effectiveness based on specific functional metrics rather than expecting universal improvements.
items.limitation: 研究中不同贴扎方法间的统计显著性差异在不同结局指标上并不一致。
items.limitationEn: Statistically significant differences between taping methods were not consistent across all outcome measures in the study.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Adding the short, digital PainSMART-educational strategy whilst patients with musculoskeletal pain wait for primary care physiotherapy: A randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: A multi-centre randomized controlled trial (n=504) found that adding a 7-minute digital pain science education film to usual physiotherapy management for musculoskeletal pain did not provide additional clinically meaningful benefits after physiotherapy commenced.
items.curatedReason: 简短的数字化疼痛教育策略在物理治疗开始后并未带来额外的临床益处，但可能在等待期间提前改善疼痛认知和自我效能。这意味着它作为入组前的辅助手段可能有用，但不能替代正式治疗。
items.titleZh: 在肌肉骨骼疼痛患者等待初级保健物理治疗期间，增加简短的数字化 PainSMART-教育策略：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心随机对照试验（n=504）发现，在肌肉骨骼疼痛患者的常规物理治疗管理中增加 7 分钟的数字化疼痛科学教育短片，在物理治疗开始后并未带来额外的临床显著益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: A short digital pain education strategy did not yield additional clinical benefits once physiotherapy commenced, but it might offer earlier improvements in pain perceptions and self-efficacy during waiting periods. This suggests its utility as an adjunct prior to formal treatment, rather than a replacement.
items.limitation: 研究发现的疼痛自我效能改善在主要分析时间点不显著，且效应量较小。
items.limitationEn: The observed improvement in pain self-efficacy was not significant at primary analysis time points, and the effect size was small.

items.title: Autonomic responses to repeated locomotor perturbations in older adults: dissociation between phasic habituation and sustained tonic arousal.
items.summary: In older adults (n=18), repeated locomotor perturbations elicited phasic sympathetic nervous system (SNS) responses that habituated over trials, but tonic arousal remained elevated, and a change in perturbation direction restored the phasic response.
items.curatedReason: 老年人在重复性步态扰动中表现出交感神经系统反应的习惯化，但在扰动方向改变时反应会重新增强。这提示基于扰动的平衡训练对老年人有益，可用于改善其对意外事件的反应。
items.titleZh: 老年人重复性步态扰动中的自主神经反应：阶段性习惯化与持续性张力性觉醒的分离。
items.summaryZh: 在老年人（n=18）中，重复的步态扰动引发的阶段性交感神经系统反应会随试验次数增加而习惯化，但张力性觉醒持续升高，且扰动方向改变时阶段性反应会重新出现。
items.curatedReasonEn: Older adults exhibit habituation in sympathetic nervous system responses to repeated gait perturbations, but the response is restored when perturbation direction changes. This suggests that perturbation-based balance training may benefit older adults by improving their reactions to unexpected events.
items.limitation: 样本量较小（n=18），且研究在跑步机上进行，其结果外推到真实世界环境时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The sample size was small (n=18), and the study was conducted on a treadmill, so caution is needed when extrapolating results to real-world environments.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Test-Retest Reliability of an Isometric Trunk Flexor and Extensor Test in Community-Dwelling Adults
items.summary: A test-retest reliability study (n=29) in healthy adults found that the VALD ForceFrame Strength Testing System showed excellent reliability for isometric trunk flexion (ICC=0.83-0.86) and extension (ICC=0.86-0.97) strength measurements.
items.curatedReason: VALD ForceFrame 系统在评估社区成人躯干屈伸肌力量变化方面显示出良好的重测信度。如果您在临床实践中需要标准化、可靠的躯干力量测量工具，该系统是一个值得考虑的选择。
items.titleZh: 社区成人等长躯干屈伸肌测试的重测信度。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对健康成人（n=29）的重测信度研究发现，VALD ForceFrame 力量测试系统在等长躯干屈曲（ICC=0.83-0.86）和伸展（ICC=0.86-0.97）力量测量中表现出卓越的信度。
items.curatedReasonEn: The VALD ForceFrame system demonstrated excellent test-retest reliability for assessing changes in trunk flexor and extensor strength in community-dwelling adults. If you require a standardized and reliable trunk strength measurement tool in your clinical practice, this system is a viable option.
items.limitation: 研究对象是健康成人，其结果在脊柱病理患者人群中的适用性有待进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study involved healthy adults, and the applicability of its findings to patients with spinal pathologies requires further validation.

items.title: Is therapeutic exercise as a standalone intervention effective in reducing kinesiophobia in adults with nonspecific chronic low back pain? A systematic review and meta-analysis with meta-regression.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 8 RCTs (n=854) found that standalone exercise therapy significantly reduced kinesiophobia in adults with nonspecific chronic low back pain compared to passive controls and usual care (MD = -5.38; 95% CI -7.63 to -3.13; SMD = -1.03), exceeding the minimal clinically important difference. However, considerable heterogeneity was observed (I² ≈ 94%), and the certainty of evidence was rated as low.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述发现，独立运动疗法能显著降低非特异性慢性下腰痛患者的运动恐惧，且效应量超出了最小临床重要差异。将运动疗法作为一线干预的证据又多了一层。
items.titleZh: 独立运动疗法对非特异性慢性下腰痛患者运动恐惧症的疗效：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 8 项随机对照试验（n=854）的系统综述与荟萃分析显示，独立运动疗法能显著降低非特异性慢性下腰痛患者的运动恐惧（MD = -5.38; 95% CI -7.63 至 -3.13; SMD = -1.03），超过了最小临床重要差异。但研究存在显著异质性（I² ≈ 94%），证据确定性较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review found that standalone exercise therapy significantly reduces kinesiophobia in adults with nonspecific chronic low back pain, with an effect size exceeding the minimal clinically important difference. This adds another layer of evidence for exercise therapy as a first-line intervention.
items.limitation: 该综述纳入的研究数量较少，且存在显著异质性，降低了对汇总效应量的信心。
items.limitationEn: The review included a small number of studies and observed considerable heterogeneity, limiting confidence in the pooled effect estimate.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Effects of Virtual Reality-Assisted Task-Oriented Training on Clinical and Psychosocial Outcomes in Individuals with Rotator Cuff Tears: A Randomized Controlled Single-Blind Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=60) found that adding virtual reality-assisted task-oriented training (VR-TOT) to conventional physiotherapy for 6 weeks significantly improved upper extremity function (DASH mean difference -3.93 points; 95% CI -4.79 to -3.08), pain, shoulder-related disability, kinesiophobia, and pain catastrophizing in individuals with rotator cuff tears. However, the DASH difference did not reach the published MCID.
items.curatedReason: 虽然附加VR-TOT能显著改善肩袖撕裂患者的上肢功能和疼痛，但DASH量表评分改善未达MCID（最小临床重要差异）。对于已在临床中使用VR的同行，可以考虑将其纳入常规物理治疗方案；但如果还没有引入VR，目前的证据尚不足以支持为此项特定改善进行设备投资。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实辅助任务导向训练对肩袖撕裂患者临床与心理社会结局的影响：一项随机对照单盲试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=60）发现，在常规物理治疗基础上增加 6 周虚拟现实辅助任务导向训练（VR-TOT），显著改善了肩袖撕裂患者的上肢功能（DASH 平均差异 -3.93 分；95% CI -4.79 至 -3.08）、疼痛、肩部相关残疾、运动恐惧和疼痛灾难化。但 DASH 评分的组间差异未达到已发布的最小临床重要差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: While adding VR-TOT to conventional physiotherapy significantly improved upper extremity function and pain in individuals with rotator cuff tears, the DASH score improvement did not reach the published MCID. If you already use VR in your practice, consider incorporating this into your treatment plans. However, if you're not currently using VR, the present evidence is insufficient to warrant investing in equipment for this specific improvement.
items.limitation: 研究的 DASH 评分组间差异未达到已发布的最小临床重要差异，且为短期随访结果。
items.limitationEn: The between-group difference in DASH scores did not reach the published minimal clinically important difference, and the findings are short-term.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Alignment between goals and subjective memory concerns in measuring outcomes of memory rehabilitation post-stroke.
items.summary: A sub-study within the Memory-SuSTAIN trial (n=38 stroke survivors) found that goal-consistent subjective memory concerns, aligned with participants' main nominated memory goal domain, significantly improved (mean change 7.68 points) after a Stroke Memory Skills Group intervention, while goal-inconsistent concerns did not significantly improve. Both improved following maintenance interventions.
items.curatedReason: 这项亚组研究提示，中风后记忆康复中，若能区分患者记忆问题是否与康复目标一致，可以更敏感地追踪干预效果。这支持了在神经康复中结合患者目标制定个体化结局指标的实践。
items.titleZh: 中风后记忆康复中目标与主观记忆担忧的一致性在测量结局中的作用
items.summaryZh: Memory-SuSTAIN 试验的一项亚组研究（n=38 名中风幸存者）发现，与患者主要记忆目标领域一致的主观记忆担忧，在中风记忆技能小组干预后显著改善（平均变化 7.68 分），而目标不一致的担忧则无显著改善。两种担忧在维持性干预后均有改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This sub-study suggests that distinguishing between goal-consistent and goal-inconsistent memory problems in post-stroke memory rehabilitation can more sensitively track intervention effects. This supports the practice of incorporating patient goals for individualized outcome measurement in neurorehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这项亚组研究样本量较小，可能限制了其结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This sub-study had a small sample size, which may limit the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Scar dry needling for tissue compliance in individuals with linear scars: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A single-center, assessor-blinded randomized controlled trial (n=80) found that scar dry needling (DN) was associated with greater tissue compliance at 5mm and 10mm depths immediately post-treatment, and at 10mm and 15mm depths at follow-up, compared to minimal needling. However, no significant or clinically meaningful between-group differences were found in local scar-related pain or health-related quality of life, and the clinical importance and durability of findings remain uncertain.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 显示，对线性瘢痕进行干针治疗，短期内可以改善某些深度的组织依从性。但别急着把干针作为瘢痕常规处理，因为其对疼痛和生活质量的长期益处尚不明确，且未达到临床意义。
items.titleZh: 线性瘢痕患者瘢痕干针治疗对组织依从性的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心、评估者盲法随机对照试验（n=80）发现，瘢痕干针治疗与微量针刺相比，在治疗后即刻和随访时，在 5mm、10mm 和 15mm 深度上，组织依从性有更大改善。然而，在局部瘢痕相关疼痛或健康相关生活质量方面未发现统计学或临床意义上的组间差异，且结果的临床重要性和持久性仍不确定。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT shows that dry needling for linear scars can short-term improve tissue compliance at certain indentation depths. However, do not rush to incorporate dry needling as a routine scar treatment, as its long-term benefits for pain and quality of life remain uncertain and did not reach clinical significance.
items.limitation: 本研究关于局部瘢痕相关疼痛的分析能力不足，且对膝关节被动屈曲的分析是探索性的，样本量很小。
items.limitationEn: The analysis regarding local scar-related pain was underpowered, and the analysis of passive knee flexion was exploratory with a very small sample size.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Centering First Nations parents' voices: a community-directed pediatric rehabilitation needs assessment in Northern Saskatchewan.
items.summary: A community-based participatory action research study, involving sharing circles and interviews with First Nations parents (n=14 children's stories) in Northern Saskatchewan, identified significant inequities in pediatric rehabilitation services. Parents highlighted challenges in navigating the healthcare system, limited community resources, and the need for strength-based, family-centered, culturally grounded, and community-led services, including hybrid in-person and virtual solutions.
items.curatedReason: 作为康复专业人员，您必须批判性地审视西方医疗系统如何建构残疾，并认识到这有损于原住民的认知和存在方式。提供公平的康复服务，您需要承认并回应原住民家庭所经历的结构性和系统性障碍。
items.titleZh: 以原住民父母之声为中心：萨斯喀彻温省北部社区导向的儿科康复需求评估
items.summaryZh: 一项基于社区的参与式行动研究，通过与萨斯喀彻温省北部原住民父母的分享圈和访谈（涉及 14 名儿童的故事），揭示了儿科康复服务中的显著不公平。父母们强调了医疗系统导航困难、社区资源有限，以及需要以优势为基础、家庭为中心、文化为根基、社区主导的服务模式，包括线上线下混合解决方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pediatric rehabilitation needs assessment in Northern Saskatchewan's First Nations communities reveals systemic inequities for Indigenous families within the current healthcare system, advocating for strength-based, family-centered, culturally grounded, and community-led service models. This prompts reflection on cultural sensitivity and service equity in your practice.
items.limitation: 本研究基于定性访谈，其发现可能无法直接推广到其他地理或文化背景的社区。
items.limitationEn: This study is based on qualitative interviews, and its findings may not be directly generalizable to communities in different geographical or cultural contexts.

items.title: Peripheral arterial disease: adverse impacts, disparities in outcomes, and the path ahead.
items.summary: The third paper in a Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD) Series describes the devastating individual effects of PAD, including chronic pain, functional limitation, and loss of independence, while highlighting disparities in outcomes among underserved groups. It recommends improving disease awareness, introducing multidisciplinary care models including exercise therapy, and modifying healthcare services to provide better access.
items.curatedReason: 这份 PAD 系列论文强调了多学科护理模型的重要性，尤其提到运动疗法作为选定患者的治疗选项，并指出医疗服务不公平性对弱势群体的影响。它重申了康复在 PAD 管理中的核心地位。
items.titleZh: 外周动脉疾病：不利影响、结局差异及未来之路
items.summaryZh: 外周动脉疾病（PAD）系列论文的第三篇描述了 PAD 对个体造成的破坏性影响，包括慢性疼痛、功能受限和独立性丧失，同时强调了弱势群体在结局上的差异。论文建议提高疾病认知、引入包括运动疗法在内的多学科护理模式，并调整医疗服务以改善可及性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PAD Series paper highlights the importance of multidisciplinary care models, specifically mentioning exercise therapy as a treatment option for selected patients, and addresses healthcare inequities affecting underserved groups. It reaffirms the central role of rehabilitation in PAD management.

items.title: Morbidity Profile and Disability Certification among Patients attending a Vision Rehabilitation Clinic in a Tertiary Care Institute of Northern India
items.summary: A cross-sectional analysis of 1,067 patients attending a vision rehabilitation clinic in Northern India found a predominantly young (45.1% aged 18-29), unemployed (88.6%), and economically weaker population. Common causes of visual impairment included retinitis pigmentosa (20.8%) and optic atrophy (13.2%). Despite eligibility, only 20.4% possessed a disability card, and almost all (99%) visited multiple health centers before rehabilitation, with critically low awareness and utilization of assistive technologies.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对印度北部视觉康复诊所患者的分析揭示了低视力群体的特点：年轻、失业、经济弱势，且多数患者在抵达康复中心前已就诊多个医疗机构，辅助技术使用率极低。该研究强调了改善早期转诊、辅助技术培训和经济支持的紧迫性，这些都是物理治疗师在跨专业转诊中应予考虑的因素。
items.titleZh: 印度北部三级医疗机构视力康复诊所患者的发病特征与残疾认证情况
items.summaryZh: 一项针对印度北部某视力康复诊所 1,067 名患者的横断面分析显示，患者群体以年轻人（45.1% 介于 18-29 岁）、失业（88.6%）和经济弱势为主。视力损害主要病因包括视网膜色素变性（20.8%）和视神经萎缩（13.2%）。尽管符合条件，仅有 20.4% 的患者持有残疾证，近 99% 的患者在康复前曾就诊多个医疗机构，且辅助技术的认知和使用率极低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This analysis of patients attending a vision rehabilitation clinic in Northern India reveals the profile of low vision individuals: young, unemployed, economically vulnerable, and often navigating multiple healthcare centers before reaching rehabilitation, with extremely low utilization of assistive technology. The study underscores the urgency of improving early referral, AT training, and financial support—factors physical therapists should consider in interprofessional referrals.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面分析，无法建立因果关系，且数据来自单一三级医疗机构，可能不具全国代表性。
items.limitationEn: This study is a cross-sectional analysis, precluding the establishment of causality, and its data from a single tertiary care institute may not be nationally representative.

items.title: Optimising exercise prescription for cancer-related fatigue, lean mass, physical function and muscle strength in women with breast cancer: a systematic review with dose-response network meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and dose-response network meta-analysis (64 trials, n=5156) found that combined exercise was most effective for improving cancer-related fatigue and lean mass, while resistance exercise was most effective for physical function and muscle strength in women with breast cancer, with significant benefits achievable at doses as low as 10–40 min/week.
items.curatedReason: 对于乳腺癌患者，结合有氧和阻力训练能最有效改善疲劳和瘦体重，而阻力训练则对体能和肌力最有效。即便每周仅需 10-40 分钟，也能带来显著益处。你应将个体化、混合型训练方案作为一线推荐，并强调低剂量也能起效。
items.titleZh: 优化乳腺癌女性癌症相关疲劳、瘦体重、体能和肌力锻炼处方：一项系统综述与剂量-反应网络 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 这项包含 64 项试验（n=5156）的系统综述和剂量-反应网络 Meta 分析发现，在乳腺癌女性中，联合运动对改善癌症相关疲劳和瘦体重最有效，而阻力运动对改善体能和肌力最有效，每周仅 10-40 分钟的低剂量也能带来显著益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: For breast cancer patients, combined aerobic and resistance exercise is most effective for fatigue and lean mass, while resistance exercise is best for physical function and strength. Even 10-40 minutes per week yields significant benefits. You should recommend individualized, mixed training programs as a first-line approach, emphasizing that low doses can also be effective.
items.limitation: 虽然提供了剂量-反应关系，但由于研究异质性，仍需在临床实践中根据个体情况精细调整，以实现最佳效果。
items.limitationEn: Although dose-response relationships are provided, due to study heterogeneity, precise individual adjustments are still needed in clinical practice to achieve optimal effects.

items.title: Effects of supervised exercise during pregnancy on gestational diabetes mellitus and other pregnancy outcomes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis (19 studies, n=6213) found that supervised exercise during pregnancy significantly reduced the risk of gestational diabetes (RR 0.74), gestational hypertension (RR 0.55), excessive gestational weight gain (RR 0.75), and macrosomia (RR 0.61), with greater effects from earlier intervention, higher adherence, combined aerobic and resistance training, and ≥150 min/week exercise.
items.curatedReason: 妊娠期在专业指导下进行运动能显著降低妊娠糖尿病、妊娠高血压、过度孕期体重增加和巨大儿的风险。建议你向孕妇推广早期干预、高依从性、结合有氧和阻力训练、每周 ≥150 分钟的中等强度运动。
items.titleZh: 妊娠期监督运动对妊娠糖尿病和其他妊娠结局的影响：一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 这项包含 19 项研究（n=6213）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，妊娠期在专业指导下进行运动能显著降低妊娠糖尿病（RR 0.74）、妊娠高血压（RR 0.55）、过度孕期体重增加（RR 0.75）和巨大儿（RR 0.61）的风险。早期干预、高依从性、结合有氧和阻力训练、以及每周 ≥150 分钟的运动能带来更大益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: Supervised exercise during pregnancy significantly reduces the risk of gestational diabetes, gestational hypertension, excessive gestational weight gain, and macrosomia. You should promote early intervention, high adherence, combined aerobic and resistance training, and moderate-intensity exercise for at least 150 minutes per week to pregnant women.
items.limitation: 尽管证据确定性为中等，但由于纳入研究存在异质性（I²值较高），在解释和应用结果时仍需考虑个体差异。
items.limitationEn: Although the certainty of evidence is moderate, due to heterogeneity among included studies (high I² values), individual differences must still be considered when interpreting and applying the results.

items.title: Short-Term Effects of Radial Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy in Addition to Physiotherapy on Spasticity, Walking Performance, and Quality of Life in Chronic Stroke: A Sham-Controlled Randomized Trial.
items.summary: This sham-controlled RCT (n=85) found that adding 4 weeks of radial extracorporeal shock wave therapy to physiotherapy significantly improved spasticity (-0.56 MAS points), walking performance (-1.41s 10MWT), functional mobility, motor function, and quality of life in chronic stroke patients with plantar flexor spasticity.
items.curatedReason: 慢性卒中患者的足底屈肌痉挛，在物理治疗基础上加用径向体外冲击波疗法（rESWT）能短期内有效改善痉挛、步态、功能性活动度和生活质量。这提示 rESWT 可能成为神经康复中的一个有力辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 径向体外冲击波疗法联合物理治疗对慢性卒中痉挛、步行表现和生活质量的短期效果：一项假对照随机试验
items.summaryZh: 这项假对照随机试验（n=85）发现，在物理治疗基础上加用为期 4 周的径向体外冲击波疗法，能显著改善慢性卒中伴足底屈肌痉挛患者的痉挛程度（MAS 评分降低 -0.56）、步行表现（10MWT 缩短 -1.41 秒）、功能性活动度、运动功能和生活质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic stroke patients with plantar flexor spasticity, adding radial extracorporeal shock wave therapy (rESWT) to physiotherapy can acutely improve spasticity, gait, functional mobility, and quality of life. This suggests rESWT could be a potent adjunct in neurorehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究仅评估了短期（4周）效果，长期疗效和安全性仍需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: This study only evaluated short-term (4-week) effects, and long-term efficacy and safety require further investigation.

items.title: High-impact physical activity participation and 12-month risk of joint replacement: a longitudinal mediation analysis of 17 661 patients with knee or hip osteoarthritis
items.summary: A longitudinal mediation analysis (n=17,661) found that high-impact physical activity was associated with 36–48% lower odds of total hip replacement (THR) at 12 months, and was not associated with an altered risk of total knee replacement (TKR) in patients with hip or knee osteoarthritis.
items.curatedReason: 高强度体力活动非但没有增加髋膝关节置换风险，反而与髋关节置换的较低风险相关。这意味着对于骨关节炎患者，在症状允许和功能容量支持下，应鼓励他们进行更高强度的活动，而不必过度规避。
items.titleZh: 高强度体力活动参与与 12 个月关节置换风险：对 17,661 名髋膝骨关节炎患者的纵向中介分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 17,661 名髋膝骨关节炎患者进行的纵向中介分析发现，高强度体力活动与 12 个月时全髋关节置换（THR）的风险降低 36%–48% 相关，且未改变全膝关节置换（TKR）的风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-impact physical activity not only did not increase the risk of hip and knee replacement, but was associated with a lower risk of hip replacement. This means that for osteoarthritis patients, they should be encouraged to engage in higher-impact activities, when symptoms allow and functional capacity supports it, without excessive avoidance.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性队列研究，尽管进行了多因素调整，但仍可能存在未测量混杂因素，不能建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was an observational cohort study; despite multi-factor adjustments, unmeasured confounders may still exist, precluding causal inference.

items.title: Effectiveness of an individualised swimming and education programme for chronic low back pain (EduSwim): a randomised controlled trial
items.summary: This RCT (n=76) found that an individualized swimming and education program was more effective than education alone for short-term (8 weeks) improvement in disability (RMDQ MD -2.5, 95% CI -4.5 to -0.5) and pain intensity in patients with chronic low back pain, though benefits were not sustained at 52 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性下腰痛，结合游泳和教育的干预方案在短期内（8 周）比单纯教育更能有效改善残疾。这意味着游泳可作为慢性腰痛患者短期干预的有效手段，但在长期效果上仍需更多支持。
items.titleZh: 个体化游泳与教育项目对慢性下腰痛的有效性（EduSwim）：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（n=76）发现，针对慢性下腰痛患者，个体化的游泳与教育项目在短期（8 周）内比单纯教育更能有效改善残疾（RMDQ 平均差异 -2.5，95% CI -4.5 至 -0.5）和疼痛强度，但其益处在 52 周时未能持续。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic low back pain, a combined swimming and education intervention is more effective than education alone for short-term (8-week) disability improvement. This suggests swimming can be an effective short-term intervention for chronic LBP, but long-term efficacy requires further support.
items.limitation: 短期内效果显著，但这种改善在 52 周时未能持续，且干预组不良事件略多，需要注意患者筛选和长期依从性。
items.limitationEn: The significant short-term effects were not sustained at 52 weeks, and the intervention group had more adverse events, necessitating careful patient screening and long-term adherence considerations.

items.title: The effects of robot assisted therapy on upper limb functions and gait parameters in cerebral palsy: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: This RCT (n=31) found that adding upper extremity robotic-assisted training to conventional physiotherapy significantly improved wrist flexion (mean change 10.37°), forearm supination (median change 17.5°), and Jebsen-Taylor Hand Function Test time (-37.67s), alongside positive impacts on gait parameters, in children with cerebral palsy.
items.curatedReason: 对于脑瘫儿童的上肢康复，在传统物理治疗基础上联合机器人辅助训练，不仅能提升上肢功能，还能对步态参数产生积极影响。考虑将机器人辅助作为儿童神经康复的增效选项。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助治疗对脑瘫患者上肢功能和步态参数的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（n=31）发现，在传统物理治疗基础上联合上肢机器人辅助训练，能显著改善脑瘫患者的腕关节屈曲（平均变化 10.37°）、前臂旋后（中位变化 17.5°）和 Jebsen-Taylor 手功能测试时间（缩短 37.67 秒），同时对步态参数产生积极影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: For upper limb rehabilitation in children with cerebral palsy, combining robot-assisted training with conventional physiotherapy can improve upper limb function and positively influence gait parameters. Consider robot assistance as an effective option for pediatric neurorehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（n=31），且随访时间有限，可能需要更大规模的长期研究来验证这些益处。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=31) and limited follow-up duration, suggesting larger, long-term studies may be needed to confirm these benefits.

items.title: Predictors of response to spinal manipulative therapy, dry needling and exercise in patients with cervicogenic headache.
items.summary: A secondary analysis (n=142) found that male sex (OR 3.906) and higher baseline headache intensity (OR 1.708) were the strongest predictors of successful outcomes (≥50% improvement) at 3 months in cervicogenic headache patients treated with spinal manipulative therapy, dry needling, and exercise.
items.curatedReason: 在颈源性头痛患者中，男性和基线头痛强度更高是脊柱手法、干针和运动联合治疗成功预后的最强预测因子。这意味着在治疗这类患者时，可将性别和初始疼痛水平作为参考因素。
items.titleZh: 颈源性头痛患者对脊柱手法治疗、干针和运动疗法反应的预测因素
items.summaryZh: 一项对 142 名颈源性头痛患者的二次分析发现，男性（OR 3.906）和较高的基线头痛强度（OR 1.708）是患者在接受脊柱手法治疗、干针和运动疗法后 3 个月内获得成功结局（疼痛改善≥50%）的最强预测因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: For cervicogenic headache patients, male sex and higher baseline headache intensity are the strongest predictors of successful outcomes with combined spinal manipulative therapy, dry needling, and exercise. This suggests that sex and initial pain levels can be used as reference factors when treating such patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为一项既往 RCT 的二次分析，结果的普适性可能受限于原始研究的设计和人群。
items.limitationEn: This study is a secondary analysis of a previous RCT, and the generalizability of the findings may be limited by the original study's design and population.

items.title: Cornerstone of healthy ageing: preserving skeletal muscle to delay age-related musculoskeletal disease and maintain functional independence
items.summary: This editorial highlights that preserving skeletal muscle mass and function is essential for healthy aging, preventing disability, and delaying the onset of age-related musculoskeletal diseases like osteoporosis and osteoarthritis, recognizing sarcopenia as a major contributor to morbidity and functional decline.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调了骨骼肌对健康老龄化的核心作用，提示我们应将保护肌肉完整性作为预防老年人残疾和延缓骨关节疾病的关键策略。在临床实践中，要重视并强化肌力训练和功能性活动。
items.titleZh: 健康老龄化的基石：保护骨骼肌以延缓衰老相关肌肉骨骼疾病并维持功能独立性
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评强调，保护骨骼肌的质量和功能对于健康老龄化、预防残疾和延缓骨质疏松、骨关节炎等衰老相关肌肉骨骼疾病至关重要，并指出肌肉减少症是导致老年人发病率和功能衰退的主要因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary underscores the central role of skeletal muscle in healthy aging, suggesting that preserving muscle integrity is a key strategy for preventing disability and delaying musculoskeletal diseases in older adults. In clinical practice, emphasize and enhance strength training and functional activities.

items.title: Exercise prehabilitation in breast cancer: an emerging target to improve surgical outcomes
items.summary: This editorial highlights exercise-based prehabilitation as a promising strategy to enhance cardiorespiratory fitness and accelerate recovery in various cancer populations, suggesting its potential to prevent postoperative complications in breast cancer patients, an area currently underexplored.
items.curatedReason: 运动预康复在乳腺癌患者中具有改善手术结局的巨大潜力，尤其是在降低术后并发症方面。作为物理治疗师，你可以将运动预康复作为乳腺癌患者围手术期管理的重要组成部分，主动与外科团队协作。
items.titleZh: 乳腺癌患者的运动预康复：改善手术结局的新兴目标
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评强调，以运动为基础的预康复是一种有前景的策略，可以提高多种癌症患者的心肺适能并加速康复，同时指出其在预防乳腺癌患者术后并发症方面的潜力尚未充分开发。
items.curatedReasonEn: Exercise prehabilitation holds great potential for improving surgical outcomes in breast cancer patients, particularly in reducing postoperative complications. As a physical therapist, you can integrate exercise prehabilitation as a critical component of perioperative management for breast cancer patients, proactively collaborating with surgical teams.

items.title: Longitudinal cohort study of the association between labral pathology and cartilage loss in high-impact athletes: the FORCe study
items.summary: A longitudinal cohort study (n=173 high-impact athletes) found weak-to-moderate associations between baseline anterior labral tears (aIRR 1.46), paralabral cysts (aIRR 1.38), and labral sum score (aIRR 1.05) with subsequent cartilage loss (sum change score) over 2-3 years, suggesting these contribute to cartilage loss.
items.curatedReason: 盂唇损伤（尤其是前盂唇撕裂和盂唇旁囊肿）与高冲击运动员髋关节软骨丢失存在关联。这意味着在评估和管理这类运动员时，应警惕盂唇损伤对软骨退变的潜在影响，并考虑制定预防策略。
items.titleZh: 盂唇病变与高冲击运动员软骨丢失关联的纵向队列研究：FORCe 研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 173 名高冲击运动员的纵向队列研究发现，基线前盂唇撕裂（调整后发生率比 1.46）、盂唇旁囊肿（1.38）和盂唇总分（1.05）与随后的 2-3 年软骨丢失（总变化评分）存在中度至弱相关性，提示这些因素可能导致软骨丢失。
items.curatedReasonEn: Labral pathology (especially anterior labral tears and paralabral cysts) is associated with hip cartilage loss in high-impact athletes. This means that when assessing and managing these athletes, clinicians should be aware of the potential impact of labral injuries on cartilage degeneration and consider developing preventive strategies.
items.limitation: 观察性研究，且盂唇损伤与软骨丢失的关联强度中等偏弱，提示还有其他重要因素影响软骨退变。
items.limitationEn: This was an observational study, and the association between labral tears and cartilage loss was modest to weak, suggesting other significant factors contribute to cartilage degeneration.

items.title: Effect of Music-Based Interventions in Cardiac Rehabilitation: A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review of 9 studies found that music-based interventions in cardiac rehabilitation (CR) improved psychological outcomes, motivation, and exercise adherence, suggesting a supportive adjunctive role rather than direct effects on cardiovascular parameters.
items.curatedReason: 音乐干预作为心脏康复的辅助手段，在改善患者心理健康、动力和运动依从性方面有积极作用，尽管其对心血管生理参数的直接影响尚不明确。您可以考虑将其整合到您的康复计划中，以提高患者的整体参与度和体验。
items.titleZh: 音乐干预对心脏康复效果的影响：一项系统综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 9 项研究的系统综述发现，音乐干预在心脏康复（CR）中能改善心理结局、动力和运动依从性，提示其作为辅助手段而非直接影响心血管参数。
items.curatedReasonEn: Music-based interventions, as an adjunct to cardiac rehabilitation, positively impact patients' psychological well-being, motivation, and exercise adherence, though their direct effects on cardiovascular physiological parameters are still unclear. You might consider integrating them into your rehabilitation programs to enhance overall patient engagement and experience.
items.limitation: 本综述纳入的研究主要报告心理和依从性结局，对心血管生理参数的直接影响尚需更多高质量研究。
items.limitationEn: Studies included in this review primarily reported psychological and adherence outcomes, with more high-quality research needed to clarify direct effects on cardiovascular physiological parameters.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Artificial Intelligence in Extended Reality and Digital Rehabilitation Technologies for Fall Prevention in Older Adults: A Rapid Review of the Evidence.
items.summary: A rapid review of four studies on AI in extended reality (XR) and virtual reality (VR) interventions for fall prevention in older adults found improvements in mobility and engagement, but limited evidence on AI-specific benefits or direct fall reduction outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 快速综述指出，扩展现实（XR）干预措施在提高老年人平衡和移动能力方面显示出潜力，但目前尚缺乏直接证实 AI 在防跌倒中附加益处的高质量证据。在将这类技术纳入临床实践时，您应关注其交互性和依从性优势，但仍需等待更多实证支持。
items.titleZh: 人工智能在扩展现实和数字康复技术中预防老年人跌倒的证据快速综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项对四项关于人工智能在扩展现实（XR）和虚拟现实（VR）干预中预防老年人跌倒的研究进行的快速综述发现，这些技术在提高移动性和参与度方面有改善，但缺乏关于 AI 具体益处或直接跌倒减少结果的证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This rapid review indicates that extended reality (XR) interventions show potential in improving balance and mobility in older adults, but currently lacks high-quality evidence directly supporting the added benefits of AI in fall prevention. When integrating such technologies into clinical practice, you should focus on their interactive and adherence advantages, while awaiting more empirical support.
items.limitation: 本快速综述仅纳入四项研究，且无研究直接测量跌倒发生率，证据基础仍非常初步。
items.limitationEn: This rapid review only included four studies, none of which directly measured fall incidence, indicating a very preliminary evidence base.

items.title: Effectiveness of photobiomodulation therapy associated with multimodal therapeutic intervention program versus multimodal therapeutic intervention program in chronic non-specific neck pain: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=62) found that adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to a multimodal therapeutic intervention program (MTIP) did not improve functional disability (4.06, 95% CI 2.83 to 5.28) or pain intensity (0.54, 95% CI 0.14 to 0.95) over MTIP alone for chronic nonspecific neck pain.
items.curatedReason: 本 RCT 提示，对于慢性非特异性颈痛，在多模式治疗方案中额外增加光生物调节疗法（PBMT）并不能带来额外的益处。临床上，在现有综合治疗方案有效的前提下，应审慎评估 PBMT 的增效价值。
items.titleZh: 慢性非特异性颈痛中，光生物调节疗法联合多模式干预与单独多模式干预的有效性对比：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=62）发现，对于慢性非特异性颈痛，在多模式治疗方案中额外增加光生物调节疗法（PBMT）并未比单独多模式干预更能改善功能障碍（4.06, 95% CI 2.83 to 5.28）或疼痛强度（0.54, 95% CI 0.14 to 0.95）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to a multimodal intervention program does not provide additional benefits for chronic nonspecific neck pain. Clinicians should cautiously evaluate the additive value of PBMT when a comprehensive treatment plan is already effective.
items.limitation: 本研究的 PBMT 剂量条件特定，结果的外推性可能受限于该特定参数。
items.limitationEn: The generalizability of the results may be limited by the specific PBMT dosage conditions used in this study.

items.title: Specialised Acquired Brain Injury Community Outreach Provision - a Service Evaluation Cohort to Enable Practice Development and Improvement.
items.summary: A service evaluation of a specialized community outreach provision in the UK (2019-2025) for acquired brain injury patients found activity doubled over six years (n=360 to n=728), with primary reasons for referral being spasticity management (n=2821) and complex physical management (n=2393).
items.curatedReason: 这项服务评估报告了英国地区性专门社区外展服务在支持脑损伤（ABI）患者复杂需求（尤其是痉挛管理）方面的扩展使用情况。它提醒您，社区服务在提供无缝护理方面面临挑战，可能需要探索多方合作模式。
items.titleZh: 专门的脑损伤社区外展服务提供——一项支持实践发展和改进的服务评估队列。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对英国脑损伤社区外展服务（2019-2025 年）的服务评估发现，六年内服务活动量翻倍（n=360 增至 n=728），主要转诊原因为痉挛管理（n=2821）和复杂身体管理（n=2393）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This service evaluation reports on the expanding utilization of a specialized community outreach service in the UK for supporting complex needs, particularly spasticity management, in patients with acquired brain injury (ABI). It highlights challenges in providing seamless care within community services and suggests exploring collaborative models.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性服务评估，缺乏对照组，无法评估干预措施的因果效应。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective service evaluation lacking a control group, thus unable to assess causal effects of interventions.

items.title:
Video-based education is non-inferior to in-person education in patients undergoing arthroscopic partial meniscectomy: a non-inferiority randomized controlled trial
							| Archives of Physiotherapy
items.summary: A non-inferiority RCT (n=166) found that preoperative video-based education was non-inferior to postoperative in-person education for pain-related self-efficacy (PSEQ MD: -0.6 at T1; -0.5 at T2) and led to better fear of movement scores (TSK) in patients undergoing arthroscopic partial meniscectomy.
items.curatedReason: 对于接受关节镜下部分半月板切除术的患者，术前视频教育在疼痛自我效能上与术后当面教育无劣效，并且能更好地减少运动恐惧。这为你的患者教育方式提供了灵活、高效的新选择，尤其是在提升依从性方面。
items.titleZh: 关节镜下部分半月板切除术患者的视频教育与当面教育的无劣效性：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=166）发现，对于接受关节镜下部分半月板切除术的患者，术前视频教育在疼痛自我效能方面（PSEQ T1 时 MD: -0.6；T2 时 MD: -0.5）与术后当面教育无劣效，并且能更好地减少运动恐惧（TSK）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Preoperative video-based education is non-inferior to postoperative in-person education for pain-related self-efficacy in patients undergoing arthroscopic partial meniscectomy, and it also better reduces kinesiophobia. This offers a flexible and efficient new option for your patient education strategies, especially in enhancing adherence.
items.limitation: 研究未评估长期随访结果，且患者可能对不同教育形式有偏好。
items.limitationEn: The study did not evaluate long-term follow-up outcomes, and patients may have preferences for different education formats.

items.title: Physical Therapy Management of Fall Risk in Community-Dwelling Older Adults (CPG+)
items.summary: APTA Geriatrics has published an updated Clinical Practice Guideline (CPG+) for the physical therapy management of fall risk in community-dwelling adults aged 65 and over, replacing the 2015 version and including a clinical reasoning algorithm.
items.curatedReason: 这份最新 CPG+ 取代了 2015 年版，为 65 岁以上社区老年人跌倒风险管理提供了更全面的 PT 指南。务必参照其临床推理算法来评估和干预跌倒风险，以确保实践与最新循证保持一致。
items.titleZh: 社区老年人跌倒风险的物理治疗管理（CPG+）
items.summaryZh: APTA 老年病学分会发布了社区居住65岁及以上老年人跌倒风险物理治疗管理临床实践指南（CPG+）的更新版本，取代了2015年的指南，并包含一个临床推理算法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This updated CPG+ replaces the 2015 version, offering a more comprehensive PT guideline for managing fall risk in community-dwelling adults aged 65 and over. You should now use its clinical reasoning algorithm for assessing and intervening in fall risk to ensure your practice aligns with the latest evidence.

items.title: Multimodal high-intensity interval training elicits greater improvements in aerobic capacity and sprint performance versus small-sided games and drill-based HIIT in adolescent basketball players: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=36) found that multimodal high-intensity interval training (M-HIIT) led to greater improvements in estimated VO₂max (+10.9%, d=2.33) and 20-m sprint time (-5.1%, d=-1.92) compared to small-sided games (SSG) and drill-based HIIT (DB-HIIT) in adolescent basketball players.
items.curatedReason: 对于青少年篮球运动员，多模式高强度间歇训练（M-HIIT）在提升有氧能力和冲刺表现方面优于传统的SSG或DB-HIIT，且不影响技术技能发展。在设计青少年运动表现训练方案时，可以考虑整合M-HIIT，以期获得更全面的生理适应。
items.titleZh: 多模式高强度间歇训练在青少年篮球运动员中对有氧能力和冲刺表现的提升优于小场比赛和钻孔式HIIT：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=36）发现，多模式高强度间歇训练（M-HIIT）在青少年篮球运动员中，比小场比赛（SSG）和钻孔式HIIT（DB-HIIT）更能显著提升最大摄氧量估值（+10.9%，d=2.33）和20米冲刺时间（-5.1%，d=-1.92）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For adolescent basketball players, multimodal high-intensity interval training (M-HIIT) superiorly improves aerobic capacity and sprint performance compared to traditional SSG or DB-HIIT, without compromising technical skill development. When designing youth sports performance training programs, consider integrating M-HIIT for more comprehensive physiological adaptations.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（n=36），且仅针对男性青少年篮球运动员，结果外推需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=36) and focused only on male adolescent basketball players, so external generalizability should be considered cautiously.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: How are biomechanical and psychosocial factors associated with injuries across one season in Swedish elite and sub-elite female soccer players?
items.summary: A prospective observational study (n=244) found that higher hip strength was associated with a lower incidence of time-loss injuries in the dominant leg among Swedish elite and sub-elite female soccer players aged 16–19.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性观察研究提示，女性足球运动员的髋部力量可能是预防下肢（尤其是优势腿）损伤的一个生物力学因素。在评估和制定预防策略时，可以将髋部力量训练作为重点关注方向。
items.titleZh: 瑞典精英及次精英女足球运动员生物力学和心理社会因素与赛季伤病的关系
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察研究（n=244）发现，在瑞典精英和次精英女性足球运动员中，较高的髋部力量与优势腿的伤停（time-loss）损伤发生率较低相关，尤其是在16-19岁年龄组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective observational study suggests that hip strength may be a biomechanical factor in preventing lower extremity injuries, especially in the dominant leg, among female soccer players. When assessing and developing prevention strategies, consider focusing on hip strengthening exercises.
items.limitation: 该观察研究无法建立因果关系，且伤病数据依赖自我报告，可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This observational study cannot establish causality, and injury data relied on self-reports, which may introduce recall bias.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Evaluation of VR-based speed and direction control strategies for pediatric robotic gait training
items.summary: This technical validation study of a VR-integrated robot-assisted gait training platform (Discover2Walk) showed robust system performance in typically developing children, with mean speed tracking errors of 10-20% and high user acceptance (enjoyment ratings >9/10), demonstrating technical feasibility for pediatric use.
items.curatedReason: 这项技术验证研究展示了VR与线缆驱动机器人步态训练系统结合的可行性，并提供了主动速度和方向控制的初步证据。在考虑儿童神经康复中的创新技术时，可以关注VR辅助机器人步态训练的进展，但仍需等待后续的临床疗效研究。
items.titleZh: VR 辅助速度与方向控制策略在儿童机器人步态训练中的评估
items.summaryZh: 这项VR集成机器人辅助步态训练平台（Discover2Walk）的技术验证研究显示，在典型发育儿童中，系统性能稳定，平均速度跟踪误差为10-20%，用户接受度高（乐趣评分>9/10），证明了其在儿科使用的技术可行性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This technical validation study demonstrates the feasibility of combining VR with cable-driven robotic gait training systems and provides preliminary evidence for active speed and direction control. When considering innovative technologies in pediatric neurological rehabilitation, monitor the advancements in VR-assisted robotic gait training, but await subsequent clinical efficacy studies.
items.limitation: 研究主要针对典型发育儿童进行技术验证，仅包含一个脑瘫病例，缺乏大规模临床疗效数据。
items.limitationEn: The study primarily conducted technical validation on typically developing children, included only one cerebral palsy case, and lacks large-scale clinical efficacy data.

items.title: The impact of COVID-19 lockdown measures on cognition and physical function of older adults in long term care facilities: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review of 12 cohort studies (n=168,911 residents) found that COVID-19 lockdown measures did not significantly worsen cognition or ADL dependency in older adults in long-term care facilities, but were associated with a trivial to small increased percentage of residents with any fall.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述发现，COVID-19 封锁措施对长期照护机构老年人的认知和身体功能恶化没有显著影响，但与跌倒发生率略有增加相关。这提示你，即使在类似疫情封锁等特殊时期，也要高度关注机构内老年人的跌倒预防，并重新评估封锁对福祉的长期影响。
items.titleZh: COVID-19 封锁措施对长期照护机构老年人认知和身体功能的影响：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对12项队列研究（涉及168,911名居民）的系统综述发现，COVID-19 封锁措施并未显著加剧长期照护机构老年人的认知或ADL依赖恶化，但与跌倒发生率的轻微至小幅增加相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review found no significant worsening of cognition or physical function due to COVID-19 lockdown measures in older adults in long-term care facilities, but noted a trivial to small increase in falls. This suggests that even during special periods like lockdowns, you must prioritize fall prevention for institutionalized older adults and re-evaluate the long-term impact of lockdowns on their well-being.
items.limitation: 纳入的研究多为观察性队列研究，证据质量为低到中等，且难以完全排除混杂因素对结果的影响。
items.limitationEn: The included studies were mostly observational cohort studies with low to moderate quality evidence, making it difficult to completely rule out confounding factors.

items.title: The effect of multimodal sensory therapy in consciousness improvement in patients with acquired brain injury: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis (18 studies, 884 participants) found that multimodal sensory therapy significantly improved consciousness levels (SMD, 1.48; 95% CI, 1.04-1.92) and increased the odds of coma emergence (OR, 9.85; 95% CI, 3.86-25.01) in adults with acquired brain injury-related disorders of consciousness.
items.curatedReason: 多模式感觉疗法对获得性脑损伤（ABI）意识障碍患者确实有效。这项纳入 884 名患者的系统综述表明，MST 不仅显著改善意识水平，还将昏迷苏醒的可能性提高了近 10 倍。你可以更自信地将 MST 整合到你的康复方案中。
items.titleZh: 多模式感觉疗法对获得性脑损伤患者意识改善效果的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析（18 项研究，884 名参与者）发现，多模式感觉疗法显著改善了获得性脑损伤伴意识障碍成年患者的意识水平（SMD, 1.48; 95% CI, 1.04-1.92），并增加了昏迷苏醒的可能性（OR, 9.85; 95% CI, 3.86-25.01）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Multimodal sensory therapy (MST) is effective for adults with acquired brain injury (ABI) and disorders of consciousness. This systematic review of 884 participants shows MST not only significantly improves consciousness levels but also increases the odds of coma emergence by nearly 10-fold. You can more confidently integrate MST into your rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 纳入研究存在方法学局限性和异质性，建议未来试验采用标准化方案和验证性评估。
items.limitationEn: Included studies had methodological limitations and heterogeneity, suggesting future trials should use standardized protocols and validated assessments.

items.title: REmotely monitored, Mobile health-supported Multidomain Rehabilitation with High Intensity Interval Training for COVID-19 (REMM-HIIT-CoV): Trial Design and Rationale.
items.summary: The REMM-HIIT-CoV trial is a multicenter, single-blinded RCT (N=140) evaluating a 12-week remotely delivered, mobile health-supported multidomain rehabilitation program with high-intensity interval training for post-hospitalized COVID-19 survivors, primarily assessing 6-minute walk distance at 3 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项正在进行的 RCT 旨在验证远程监测、移动健康支持的多领域康复结合高强度间歇训练（HIIT）对新冠住院患者出院后功能锻炼能力的改善作用。其结果有望为严重呼吸道感染后居家远程康复提供循证指南和政策相关模型。
items.titleZh: REMM-HIIT-CoV：远程监测、移动健康支持结合高强度间歇训练治疗 COVID-19 的多领域康复试验设计与原理
items.summaryZh: REMM-HIIT-CoV 试验是一项多中心、单盲随机对照试验（N=140），旨在评估一项为期 12 周的远程交付、移动健康支持的多领域康复计划（包含高强度间歇训练）对新冠住院幸存者的效果，主要评估 3 个月时的 6 分钟步行距离。
items.curatedReasonEn: The efficacy of remotely delivered, mobile health-supported multidomain rehabilitation combined with high-intensity interval training (HIIT) for post-hospitalized COVID-19 survivors is not yet established. This 140-person RCT, primarily assessing 6-minute walk distance at 3 months, is worth watching. If effective, it could provide crucial evidence for home-based remote rehabilitation.

items.title: Item-level analysis and network analysis of the functional independence measure cognitive items at discharge after acute stroke.
items.summary: A retrospective observational study (N=974) analyzed FIM cognitive items at discharge after acute stroke, identifying item-level heterogeneity and two major conditional associations: comprehension-expression (r=0.71) and memory-problem solving (r=0.55).
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提供了 FIM 认知子量表在卒中患者出院时的项目层面分析，揭示了理解-表达和记忆-问题解决的条件关联。这有助于你在出院计划时，更精细地解读 FIM 认知评分，识别患者的具体认知异质性。
items.titleZh: 急性卒中患者出院时功能独立性评定（FIM）认知项目的项目层面与网络分析
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性观察研究（N=974）分析了急性卒中患者出院时的 FIM 认知项目，发现项目层面存在异质性，并揭示了两个主要的条件关联：理解-表达（r=0.71）和记忆-问题解决（r=0.55）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study provides an item-level analysis of FIM cognitive subscale at discharge in stroke patients, revealing conditional associations between comprehension-expression and memory-problem solving. This helps you interpret FIM cognitive scores more precisely during discharge planning, identifying specific cognitive heterogeneity in patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性观察设计，且缺乏与外部结局的纵向验证。
items.limitationEn: This study is a retrospective observational design and lacks longitudinal validation against external outcomes.

items.title: Age, resilience, social support, and health literacy as predictors of functional ability in people with spinal cord injury: a 6-month follow-up study.
items.summary: A 6-month follow-up study of 367 inpatients with traumatic SCI found that younger age (β = -0.02; p = 0.028), higher resilience (β = 0.22; p < 0.001), and higher health literacy (β = 0.32; p = 0.001) were independent predictors of greater functional ability, though overall improvement was modest (MBI 43.50 to 46.81).
items.curatedReason: 这项单中心随访研究提示，脊髓损伤患者出院后前 6 个月的功能恢复，除了年龄，还跟你的心理韧性、健康素养相关。临床上，在常规康复计划中整合心理支持和健康教育，可能为年轻患者带来额外助益。
items.titleZh: 年龄、心理韧性、社会支持和健康素养在脊髓损伤患者功能能力中的预测作用：一项 6 个月随访研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 367 名创伤性脊髓损伤住院患者的 6 个月随访研究发现，虽然总体功能改善幅度不大（MBI 从 43.50 升至 46.81），但更年轻的年龄（β = -0.02）、更高的心理韧性（β = 0.22）和更高的健康素养（β = 0.32）是功能能力更佳的独立预测因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This single-center follow-up study suggests that functional recovery in the first 6 months post-discharge for SCI patients is associated with age, psychological resilience, and health literacy. Clinically, integrating psychological support and health education into routine rehabilitation plans may provide additional benefits for younger patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心观察性研究，且功能改善的幅度非常有限，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center observational study, and the observed improvement in functional ability was modest, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Stroke survivors' experience using mechanically-assisted devices as a component of their upper limb motor rehabilitation program.
