items.summary: A qualitative study interviewing 11 stroke survivors (mean age 63.2 years, less than 6 months post-stroke) identified five major themes regarding their experience with mechanically-assisted upper limb devices, emphasizing intrinsic motivation, goal-oriented feedback, and the crucial role of clinician involvement.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了卒中患者使用机械辅助上肢康复设备的复杂体验。作为临床医师，你应在提供设备时注重激发患者内在动机，确保反馈目标导向，并积极参与设备的设置和调整，不能只把设备推给患者。
items.titleZh: 卒中幸存者将机械辅助设备作为上肢运动康复项目组成部分的体验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 11 名卒中幸存者（平均年龄 63.2 岁，卒中后不到 6 个月）的定性访谈研究揭示了他们使用机械辅助上肢设备的五大主题，强调了内在动机、目标导向反馈以及临床医师关键作用的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the complex experiences of stroke survivors using mechanically-assisted upper limb rehabilitation devices. As a clinician, you should focus on fostering intrinsic motivation and providing goal-oriented feedback when offering devices, and actively participate in device setup and adjustments, rather than merely assigning the device to the patient.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量小（11 人），结果的普遍性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (11 participants), limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Exercise-only interventions and exercise-based multidomain lifestyle interventions to promote cognitive function in older adults without dementia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 227 studies found that exercise-only interventions significantly improved executive functions, memory, and processing speed in older adults without dementia compared to control. Exercise-plus interventions (exercise combined with other lifestyle factors) were significantly better than control for memory, and better than exercise-only for executive functions and processing speed, but not memory.
items.curatedReason: 运动仍是老年人维持认知功能的一线方案。这项纳入 227 项研究的系统综述证实，单纯运动能显著改善执行功能、记忆和处理速度；若想在执行功能和处理速度上更进一步，再结合其他干预，效果会优于单纯运动。
items.titleZh: 单纯运动干预及基于运动的多领域生活方式干预对无痴呆老年人认知功能的影响：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 227 项研究的系统综述和荟萃分析显示，与对照组相比，单纯运动干预能显著改善无痴呆老年人的执行功能、记忆力和处理速度。而运动加其他生活方式干预（Exercise-Plus）在记忆力方面优于对照组，且在执行功能和处理速度方面优于单纯运动干预，但在记忆力方面无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Exercise remains the first-line strategy for maintaining cognitive function in older adults. This systematic review of 227 studies confirms that exercise alone significantly improves executive functions, memory, and processing speed. If you aim for greater gains in executive functions and processing speed, combining exercise with other interventions will be superior to exercise alone.
items.limitation: 多域干预的具体组成和剂量在不同研究中可能存在异质性，影响其普遍适用性。
items.limitationEn: The specific composition and dosage of multi-domain interventions may vary across studies, affecting their general applicability.

items.title: Perceptions and Experiences of Returning to Sport Following Myocardial Infarction: A Qualitative Study.
items.summary: This qualitative study explored perceptions and experiences of returning to sport after a myocardial infarction, identifying themes like reconciling active identity with new reality, feeling vulnerable, needing strong support, and navigating their own path, highlighting significant psychosocial challenges alongside high motivation.
items.curatedReason: 心脏病发作后的运动重返不只是体能问题，心理因素同样关键。本研究提醒你除了运动处方，还要关注患者的身份认同、恐惧以及提供个体化的支持，别只盯着生理指标。
items.titleZh: 心肌梗死后重返运动的感知与经验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究探讨了心肌梗死后重返运动的感知与经验，揭示了将运动身份与新现实调和、脆弱感、需要强力支持和自我探索路径等主题，强调了心理社会挑战与高动机并存。
items.curatedReasonEn: Returning to sport after a myocardial infarction isn't just about physical readiness; psychosocial factors are equally crucial. This study reminds you to address patients' identity, fears, and provide individualized support beyond just exercise prescriptions, rather than solely focusing on physiological metrics.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，仅限于理解个体感知和经验，不提供干预的疗效证据。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study is limited to understanding individual perceptions and experiences and does not provide evidence on intervention efficacy.

items.title: The Effects of Exergames on Fundamental Movement Skills in Childhood: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 12 studies (17 comparisons) concluded that low-barrier exergames are as effective as traditional activities for fundamental movement skill adaptation in children. The variability in effects was explained by coaching and activity structure, rather than exergame status itself.
items.curatedReason: 儿童基本运动技能适应，低门槛体感游戏和传统活动一样有效，重点在教练和活动结构。放心地把体感游戏纳入儿科康复方案吧，它们的效果不逊于传统方法，关键在于如何设计和指导。
items.titleZh: 体感游戏对儿童基本运动技能的影响：系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 12 项研究（17 项比较）的系统综述和 Meta 分析得出结论，低门槛体感游戏在儿童基本运动技能适应方面与传统活动同样有效。效果差异主要由教练和活动结构解释，而非体感游戏本身。
items.curatedReasonEn: Low-barrier exergames are as effective as traditional activities for fundamental movement skill adaptation in children; the key lies in coaching and activity structure. Feel confident integrating exergames into pediatric rehab plans, as their efficacy is comparable to traditional methods, provided they are well-designed and guided.
items.limitation: 研究关注的是实验条件下的技能适应，尚需更多研究来评估体感游戏在真实社区环境和长期生活方式干预中的效果。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on skill adaptation under experimental conditions; more research is needed to evaluate the effects of exergames in real-world community settings and as long-term lifestyle interventions.

items.title: Real-time continuous assessment of fatigue from surface electromyography with deep learning for training load regulation in elite cyclists
items.summary: A deep learning model combining CNN, Bi-LSTM, and channel attention mechanisms was developed to continuously estimate fatigue from raw sEMG signals during high-intensity cycling in 14 elite cyclists. The model achieved a mean absolute error of 0.048 ± 0.019 and a Pearson correlation of 0.822 ± 0.123, showing superior accuracy over baseline models.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究展示的深度学习模型能从 sEMG 信号实时评估运动员疲劳，精度可观。对于运动康复医师来说，这预示着未来在训练负荷管理和伤病预防方面，能有更客观、精细的工具。
items.titleZh: 利用深度学习从表面肌电信号实时连续评估疲劳，用于精英自行车运动员训练负荷调节
items.summaryZh: 一项深度学习模型，结合了 CNN、Bi-LSTM 和通道注意力机制，用于在 14 名精英自行车运动员高强度骑行中，从原始表面肌电信号连续估计疲劳。该模型实现了 0.048 ± 0.019 的平均绝对误差和 0.822 ± 0.123 的皮尔逊相关系数，显示出优于基线模型的准确性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The deep learning model presented in this study demonstrates impressive accuracy in real-time fatigue assessment from sEMG signals in athletes. For sports rehabilitation clinicians, this heralds more objective and precise tools for training load management and injury prevention in the future.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（14 名精英自行车运动员），且是单项冲刺运动，模型的外推性尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a small sample size (14 elite cyclists) and focused on a single sprint exercise, so the generalizability of the model is not yet clear.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Neurophysiological and neuromuscular responses associated with the repeated bout effect following eccentric exercise in healthy adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 12 studies found that peripheral contractile outcomes showed the most consistent recovery-compatible pattern after repeated eccentric exercise bouts. Evidence concerning central activation and motor-unit behavior was limited or inconsistent, leaving the contribution of neural changes to the repeated bout effect unresolved.
items.curatedReason: 重复离心运动效应（RBE）背后的神经生理学机制，目前看来外周收缩功能改变的证据最强。中枢激活和运动单位行为的作用证据有限且不一致，别急着把RBE归因于神经募集的改变。
items.titleZh: 健康成人离心运动后重复训练效应相关的神经生理与神经肌肉反应：系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 12 项研究的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，在重复离心运动后，外周收缩结果表现出最一致的恢复相容模式。关于中枢激活和运动单位行为的证据有限或不一致，重复训练效应中神经变化的具体贡献仍未解决。
items.curatedReasonEn: For the neurophysiological mechanisms behind the repeated bout effect (RBE), peripheral contractile changes show the most consistent evidence. Evidence for central activation and motor-unit behavior is limited and inconsistent; don't hastily attribute RBE to changes in neural recruitment.
items.limitation: 由于纳入研究数量较少，所有汇总分析都被视为探索性的，且研究间异质性可能影响结果的稳定性。
items.limitationEn: Due to the small number of included studies, all pooled analyses were considered exploratory, and inter-study heterogeneity might affect result stability.

items.title: Lumbar disc herniation with giant extruded or sequestered morphology: feasibility of a conservative-first strategy and the stratification value of contrast-enhanced MRI
items.summary: A prospective observational cohort of 60 patients with giant extruded or sequestered lumbar disc herniation showed an 11.7% surgery conversion rate within 24 months, with 88.3% achieving nonoperative success. Rim enhancement on MRI was associated with greater 6-month volume reduction but its value for predicting surgery conversion was exploratory.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，即便巨大腰椎间盘突出（突出或游离），保守治疗的成功率也接近九成。这强化了当前指南，即这类患者并非必须立即手术。不过，MRI 强化特征的临床分层价值仍需更多验证。
items.titleZh: 巨大突出或游离型腰椎间盘突出：保守治疗的可行性与增强 MRI 的分层价值
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察队列研究显示，60 例巨大突出或游离型腰椎间盘突出患者在 24 个月内手术转化率为 11.7%，88.3% 的患者保守治疗成功。MRI 边缘强化与 6 个月时椎间盘体积更大程度缩小相关，但其对手术转化的预测价值仍属探索性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that even with giant extruded or sequestered lumbar disc herniation, conservative treatment has a success rate of nearly 90%. This reinforces current guidelines that immediate surgery is not mandatory for these patients. However, the stratification value of MRI enhancement features still requires further validation.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心观察性队列研究，且样本量较小（60 例），结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center observational cohort study with a small sample size (60 patients), limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Pelvic morphology decoupling from lumbar lordosis in chronic low back pain
items.summary: A cross-sectional study compared 72 healthy volunteers and 72 chronic low back pain (CLBP) patients, finding that in CLBP, lumbar lordosis was decoupled from pelvic morphology. The sacral base angle (SBA) exhibited an amplified relationship with lordosis in CLBP patients, suggesting a biomechanical pattern of pelvic retroversion.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现慢性腰痛患者的腰椎前凸与骨盆形态之间的耦合关系减弱，转而更依赖骶骨倾斜。这为制定个性化的矢状面康复方案提供了新的生物力学靶点。
items.titleZh: 慢性腰痛中骨盆形态与腰椎前凸的解耦
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究比较了 72 名健康志愿者和 72 名慢性腰痛患者，发现在慢性腰痛患者中，腰椎前凸与骨盆形态之间存在解耦现象。骶骨底角（SBA）与腰椎前凸的关系在慢性腰痛患者中表现出三倍的放大效应，提示骨盆后倾的生物力学模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that the coupling between lumbar lordosis and pelvic morphology is weakened in chronic low back pain patients, becoming more dependent on sacral inclination. This provides a new biomechanical target for developing individualized sagittal rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，不能建立因果关系，且对照组与慢性腰痛组在年龄和性别构成上存在显著差异。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study that cannot establish causality, and there were significant differences in age and sex composition between the control and chronic low back pain groups.

items.title: Prognostic value of mNUTRIC and nutritional indices, including early change, for ICU mortality in older adults with AECOPD
items.summary: A single-center retrospective study of 319 older adults with AECOPD found that the mNUTRIC score (AUC 0.852) was a strong independent predictor of ICU mortality. In contrast, the Prognostic Nutritional Index (PNI) and its early change (ΔPNI) on day 3 showed limited prognostic value.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，在需要 ICU 入住的老年慢阻肺急性加重患者中，基线 mNUTRIC 评分能有效预测 ICU 死亡率，但入院后第三天的 PNI 变化没有额外预后价值。这提示我们在评估患者预后时，应更关注全面的基线营养风险评估。
items.titleZh: mNUTRIC 和营养指数（包括早期变化）对老年慢阻肺急性加重患者 ICU 死亡率的预后价值
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 319 名老年慢阻肺急性加重患者的单中心回顾性研究发现，mNUTRIC 评分（AUC 0.852）是 ICU 死亡率的强独立预测因子。相比之下，预后营养指数（PNI）及其第 3 天的早期变化（ΔPNI）显示出有限的预后价值。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that the baseline mNUTRIC score effectively predicts ICU mortality in older adults with AECOPD requiring ICU admission, but the PNI change by day 3 offers no additional prognostic value. This suggests a focus on comprehensive baseline nutritional risk assessment when evaluating patient prognosis.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心回顾性研究，样本量中等（319 例），且未直接测量衰弱，可能限制了结论的普适性。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center retrospective study with a moderate sample size (319 patients) and did not directly measure frailty, potentially limiting the generalizability of the conclusions.

items.title: A pilot randomized trial of a solution-focused, telehealth-supported transitional care program in older adults with heart failure
items.summary: A pilot randomized controlled trial with 56 older adults with heart failure found a solution-focused, telehealth-supported transitional care program (SF-TSTCP) to be feasible and acceptable. The SF-TSTCP improved discharge preparation, transitional care quality, and quality of life at 30 and 90 days post-discharge (p < 0.05), but did not significantly impact readmissions or other health service utilization.
items.curatedReason: 这项小规模随机试验显示，针对心力衰竭老年患者的远程医疗支持过渡期护理项目可行且可接受，并改善了出院准备、护理质量和生活质量。虽然仍是初步结果，但它支持了远程医疗在居家康复中的潜力。
items.titleZh: 一项针对心力衰竭老年患者的以解决方案为中心、远程医疗支持的过渡期护理项目的初步随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 56 名心力衰竭老年患者的初步随机对照试验发现，以解决方案为中心、远程医疗支持的过渡期护理项目（SF-TSTCP）是可行且可接受的。SF-TSTCP 在出院后 30 和 90 天改善了出院准备、过渡期护理质量和生活质量（p < 0.05），但对再入院或其他医疗服务利用没有显著影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small pilot randomized trial demonstrates that a telehealth-supported transitional care program for older adults with heart failure is feasible and acceptable, improving discharge preparation, care quality, and quality of life. While preliminary, these findings support the potential of telehealth in home-based rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的试点随机试验，样本量较小（56 例），且未显示对再入院率等硬性结局的显著影响，结果需大规模试验验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary pilot randomized trial with a small sample size (56 patients) and did not show significant impact on hard outcomes like readmission rates, thus results need validation in larger trials.

items.title: Beliefs and Practices of Pediatric Physiotherapists in Türkiye Regarding Early Mobility and Crawling.
items.summary: A survey of 109 pediatric physiotherapists in Türkiye found that 94.5% believed crawling was important for development, and 63% opposed its removal from CDC checklists. These beliefs influenced their clinical practice, with many reporting they would train hands-and-knees crawling.
items.curatedReason: 土耳其 PT 普遍看重爬行在儿童发育中的作用，并倾向于在临床中训练爬行。这提醒我们，在不同文化和实践背景下，对儿童运动发育里程碑的理解和干预策略可能存在差异。
items.titleZh: 土耳其儿科物理治疗师关于早期运动和爬行的信念与实践
items.summaryZh: 一项针对土耳其 109 名儿科物理治疗师的调查显示，94.5% 的受访者认为爬行对儿童发育很重要，63% 反对将其从 CDC 发育里程碑清单中删除。这些信念也影响了他们的临床实践，许多人表示会在临床上适当时训练手膝爬行。
items.curatedReasonEn: Turkish PTs widely emphasize the role of crawling in child development and tend to train it clinically. This highlights how understanding and intervention strategies for pediatric motor developmental milestones can vary across cultures and practice contexts.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面在线调查，存在受访者偏差和回忆偏差，且结果仅代表土耳其儿科物理治疗师的观点，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional online survey is subject to respondent and recall bias, and its findings represent only the views of pediatric physical therapists in Türkiye, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Prediction model for timing of independent walking on varied surface conditions in patients with early subacute stroke: A multicenter prospective study.
items.summary: A multicenter prospective observational study developed and internally validated a Cox proportional hazards model using six admission predictors to predict the timing of independent walking (FAC 5) on varied surfaces in early subacute stroke patients. The model showed favorable internal performance (AUC 0.86-0.92, calibration slope 0.92).
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，基于入院时 6 个预测因子建立的 Cox 模型，在预测亚急性卒中患者何时能实现多变路况下的独立行走（FAC 5）方面，具有一定的内部预测效能（AUC 0.86-0.92）。但这只是初步证据，还需外部验证才能在临床决策中考虑。
items.titleZh: 预测亚急性卒中患者在多变路况下独立行走时间的模型：一项多中心前瞻性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心前瞻性观察研究开发并内部验证了一个 Cox 比例风险模型，该模型使用六个入院预测因子，旨在预测亚急性卒中患者在多变路况下实现独立行走 (FAC 5) 的时间。该模型显示出良好的内部预测性能 (AUC 0.86-0.92，校准斜率 0.92)。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that a Cox model based on 6 admission predictors has some internal predictive power for timing of independent walking (FAC 5) on varied surfaces in subacute stroke patients (AUC 0.86-0.92). However, this is preliminary evidence requiring external validation before clinical consideration.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性研究，且模型仅进行了内部验证，其在更广泛人群中的外部泛化能力尚待验证。
items.limitationEn: This was an observational study, and the model only underwent internal validation; its external generalizability across broader populations remains unverified.

items.title: Music-based interventions in adult stroke rehabilitation: a narrative review of clinical applications, proposed mechanisms, and implementation.
items.summary: A narrative review on music-based interventions in adult stroke rehabilitation found consistent evidence for rhythmic auditory stimulation in gait and selected music-supported upper-limb programs, with other applications showing potential but requiring more robust research.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述清晰地总结了音乐干预在卒中康复中的应用现状，指出节律性听觉刺激对步态、音乐辅助上肢训练的证据最为一致。在将音乐干预纳入临床实践时，你需要明确目标并根据患者偏好进行个性化设置。
items.titleZh: 成人卒中康复中基于音乐的干预：临床应用、机制和实施的叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一项关于成人卒中康复中音乐干预的叙述性综述发现，节律性听觉刺激对步态、音乐辅助上肢训练的证据最为一致，其他应用显示出潜力但需要更坚实的研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review clearly summarizes the current state of music-based interventions in stroke rehabilitation, noting that rhythmic auditory stimulation for gait and music-supported upper-limb programs have the most consistent evidence. When incorporating music interventions, you should define clear targets and personalize based on patient preference.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，未进行正式的偏倚风险评估或定量汇总，可能存在作者选择性偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a narrative review, not undertaking formal risk-of-bias assessment or quantitative pooling, which may introduce author-selection bias.

items.title: Low-Level Laser Therapy Versus Mirror Therapy for Post-Stroke Complex Regional Pain Syndrome Type I: A Randomised Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=44) comparing low-level laser therapy (LLLT) and mirror therapy (MT) for post-stroke CRPS-I found LLLT provided an early significant advantage at 4 weeks in pain reduction (p=0.039) and sensorimotor recovery (p=0.022), but no significant long-term difference between groups.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 首次比较了低能量激光疗法 (LLLT) 和镜像疗法 (MT) 在卒中后复杂区域疼痛综合征 (CRPS-I) 中的效果。结果提示 LLLT 在早期（4 周）可能在疼痛缓解和感觉运动恢复方面有优势，但长期来看两种疗法效果相当。在初期治疗策略选择时，可以考虑 LLLT。
items.titleZh: 低能量激光疗法对比镜像疗法治疗卒中后复杂区域疼痛综合征 I 型：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=44）比较了低能量激光疗法 (LLLT) 和镜像疗法 (MT) 在卒中后复杂区域疼痛综合征 (CRPS-I) 中的效果，发现在 4 周时 LLLT 在疼痛减轻 (p=0.039) 和感觉运动恢复 (p=0.022) 方面显示出早期显著优势，但长期来看两组间无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT is the first to compare low-level laser therapy (LLLT) and mirror therapy (MT) for post-stroke Complex Regional Pain Syndrome Type I (CRPS-I). It suggests LLLT may offer an early advantage (4 weeks) in pain reduction and sensorimotor recovery, though long-term outcomes are comparable. Consider LLLT in initial treatment planning.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小 (n=44)，且随访时间相对较短 (12 周)。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size (n=44) and a short follow-up period (12 weeks).
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Australian Occupational Health Physiotherapy from 1970-1990: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the development of Australian Occupational Health Physiotherapy from 1970-1990, revealing the influence of the Repetitive Strain Injury epidemic, barriers in conventional education and legislation, and physiotherapists' adaptability.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究描绘了 1970-1990 年间澳大利亚职业健康物理治疗的发展历程，揭示了 RSI 疫情、传统教育和立法障碍，以及行业适应性如何塑造了这一专业领域。你可以借此了解该领域在澳大利亚的发展脉络。
items.titleZh: 1970-1990 年间澳大利亚职业健康物理治疗：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了 1970-1990 年间澳大利亚职业健康物理治疗的发展，揭示了重复性劳损 (RSI) 疫情的影响、传统教育和立法障碍，以及物理治疗师的适应能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study outlines the development of Australian occupational health physiotherapy from 1970-1990, highlighting the impact of the RSI epidemic, educational and legislative barriers, and the profession's adaptability. Use this to understand the historical context of the field in Australia.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且仅限于通过访谈回顾历史经验，可能存在回忆偏倚和主观性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size and relies on retrospective interviews, which may introduce recall bias and subjectivity.
